items.title: 集邦：全球OLED螢幕Q3出貨年增翻倍 華碩穩坐龍頭、微星首次衝上第二
items.title_en: TrendForce: Global OLED Screen Shipments Double YoY in Q3, ASUS Remains Leader, MSI Rises to Second for First Time
paras: 根據集邦科技最新調查，2026年第三季全球OLED螢幕出貨動能強勁，單季出貨量季增13%，與2025年同期相比，更呈現翻倍躍升。市場成長主因除各大品牌持續推出新機、推升出貨規模外，上游面板供應充裕亦為關鍵助力，帶動二線、新進品牌的出貨量體顯著擴大，其中華碩(2357-TW)穩居出貨第一，微星(2377-TW)首次拿下市佔第二。
集邦科技表示，受各品牌布局策略與產品線調整影響，第三季OLED螢幕市場競爭激烈，出貨第二至第五名迎來大幅更動，反映出中段班品牌間的競爭已進入白熱化階段。
在群雄並起的態勢下，華碩以21.7%的市占率穩居全球出貨冠軍。受惠於27吋QHD 540Hz關鍵高階面板供應缺口順利回補，加上品牌20週年紀念款新機正式開賣拉動買氣，帶動其出貨量穩健季增6%。
微星第三季市占率較前季增加1.7個百分點，達14.5%，排名上升至全球第二名，前三季累計出貨表現與三星大致持平。微星第三季出貨成長動能主要來自27吋QHD機種迎來節慶檔期拉貨潮，加上27吋QHD 320Hz等多款新品相繼上市，提升整體季度出貨表現。
三星(005908-KS)今年第一至第三季出貨量維持穩定步調，但在整體市場規模迅速擴大的背景下，市占率遭到稀釋，第三季下滑至11.3%，排名退居全球第三。面對競爭壓力，三星在第四季將全面發力，鎖定歐美年底傳統購物節慶大舉衝刺出貨量，屆時有望重返市場第二名的位置。
樂金電子第三季針對旗下部分27吋QHD 240Hz機種祭出積極促銷方案，成功帶動買氣，推升其單季市占率達8.6%，排名前進一名，來到全球第四。
戴爾(DELL-US)第三季出貨表現回溫，單季市占率達8.2%，排名回升一名至全球第五。其成長動能主要來自27吋QHD 240Hz主流機種出貨規模持續放大，加上第二季上市的39吋新機在第三季加速放量，成功帶動整體出貨量能擴增。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest survey, global OLED screen shipments showed strong momentum in Q3 2026, with a quarter‑over‑quarter increase of 13% and a year‑over‑year jump that doubled the previous level. The market growth was driven not only by major brands continuously launching new devices and expanding shipment volumes, but also by ample upstream panel supply, which helped second‑tier and newcomer brands significantly expand their shipments. Among them, ASUS (2357‑TW) stayed at the top of shipments, while MSI (2377‑TW) claimed the second spot for the first time.

TrendForce noted that, due to brand positioning strategies and product‑line adjustments, competition in the OLED screen market intensified in the third quarter, causing large shifts among the second‑through‑fifth ranked manufacturers and indicating that rivalry among mid‑range brands has entered a fierce stage.

Amid the crowded field, ASUS held the global shipment lead with a 21.7% market share. Benefiting from the timely replenishment of a key high‑end 27‑inch QHD 540 Hz panel shortage and the launch of a 20‑year anniversary edition model that boosted demand, its shipments grew solidly by 6% quarter‑over‑quarter.

MSI’s Q3 market share rose by 1.7 percentage points to 14.5%, moving it up to the global second position, with its cumulative shipments for the first three quarters roughly matching Samsung’s. The growth momentum came mainly from a festive‑season surge in demand for its 27‑inch QHD models, as well as the rollout of several new products such as a 27‑inch QHD 320 Hz panel, which together lifted its quarterly shipment performance.

Samsung (005908‑KS) maintained a stable shipment pace from Q1 through Q3 this year, but its market share was diluted as the overall market expanded rapidly, slipping to 11.3% in Q3 and dropping to third place globally. Facing competitive pressure, Samsung plans to go all‑out in Q4, targeting the year‑end European and American shopping festivals to surge shipments and aim to reclaim the second‑largest market position.

LG Electronics launched aggressive promotions for some of its 27‑inch QHD 240 Hz models in Q3, successfully stimulating demand and raising its quarterly market share to 8.6%, moving up one rank to fourth place worldwide.

Dell (DELL‑US) saw its Q3 shipment performance rebound, achieving an 8.2% market share for the quarter and climbing one spot to fifth globally. Its growth was driven by continued expansion of its mainstream 27‑inch QHD 240 Hz models and the accelerated volume ramp‑up of a new 39‑inch model introduced in Q2, which together boosted overall shipment capacity.

items.title: 破天荒！傳蘋果與三星將達成長期DRAM供應協議　專家：記憶體供應鏈話語權逆轉
items.title_en: Unprecedented! Apple and Samsung Near Long-Term DRAM Supply Agreement, Experts Say Memory Supply Chain Power Reverses
paras: 記憶體晶片價格持續上漲，正悄然反轉供應商與客戶之間的強弱關係。外媒引述知情人士報導，蘋果與三星電子正接近達成一項DRAM長期供應協議(LTA)，期限四至五年，預計自明年上半年開始交付。這在習慣以短期合約壓價的蘋果採購史上是罕見破例。
知情人士透露，雙方將鎖定合約期內的DRAM最低供應量，但價格不會固定，而是依屆時市場行情調整。對蘋果而言，這是用價格彈性換供貨確定性；對三星而言，則可在較長週期內鎖住訂單與收入。
據悉，此前蘋果是主要科技巨頭中唯一與三星未簽訂DRAM長期供應協議的企業，此次轉向意義重大。
知情人士還指出，蘋果近期也與另一大記憶體供應商SK海力士簽署類似長約，條款同樣更偏向供應商。背後推力來自AI資料中心對HBM的爆發式需求。
三星、SK海力士與美光三大記憶體廠產能正向伺服器產品傾斜，手機與PC用的DRAM供給被壓縮，蘋果不得不放棄逐輪砍價策略。
隨著一連串LTA落地，「晶片通膨」持續的預期正在升溫。近期合約普遍以當前高價設定供應價格下限，意味著未來成本難有大幅回落空間。
分析師警告，若記憶體漲價持續傳導至手機、電腦終端，消費者可能延後換機，反過來在中長期拖累記憶體半導體需求。
目前，蘋果與三星均未對協議細節與金額作出回應。
paras_en: Memory chip prices continue to rise, quietly reversing the power balance between suppliers and customers. Foreign media, citing insiders, report that Apple and Samsung Electronics are close to reaching a long-term DRAM supply agreement (LTA) lasting four to five years, with deliveries expected to begin in the first half of next year. This is a rare break from Apple’s usual practice of using short-term contracts to drive prices down.

Insiders say the parties will lock in a minimum supply volume for the contract period, but the price will not be fixed; it will adjust according to market conditions at the time. For Apple, this trades price flexibility for supply certainty; for Samsung, it locks in orders and revenue over a longer horizon.
Previously, Apple was the only major tech giant that had not signed a long-term DRAM supply agreement with Samsung, making this shift highly significant.

Insiders also note that Apple recently signed a similar long-term deal with another major memory supplier, SK Hynix, with terms also favoring the supplier. The driving force behind this is the explosive demand for HBM from AI data centers.

Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron’s production capacity is increasingly skewed toward server products, compressing the supply of DRAM for phones and PCs, forcing Apple to abandon its round-by-round price-cutting strategy.

With a series of LTAs coming into force, the expectation of ongoing "chip inflation" is heating up. Recent contracts generally set the supply price floor at current high levels, meaning future costs are unlikely to see a significant drop.

Analysts warn that if memory price increases continue to filter into mobile phones and computers, consumers may postpone device upgrades, which in turn could drag down memory semiconductor demand in the medium to long term.
At present, neither Apple nor Samsung has responded to inquiries about the details or amounts of the agreement.

items.title: 技嘉旗下技鋼參展SC26 大秀GIGAPOD與高密度液冷機櫃
items.title_en: GIGABYTE’s TechSteel Showcases GIGAPOD and High-Density Liquid-Cooled Racks at SC26
paras: 技嘉(2376-TW)旗下技鋼科技參與11月17日至19日在美國芝加哥McCormick Place舉行的Supercomputing 2026，於展位2229聚焦機櫃級基礎架構與自主代理式AI。呼應大會HPC Unites主題，技鋼在現場展示運算、液冷與夥伴生態系的整合方案，完整產品組合涵蓋從輕巧的個人AI超級電腦到機櫃級AI基礎架構。
隨著超大規模雲端業者與AI雲端服務供應商崛起，資料中心重心已轉向大規模機櫃級部署，技鋼自推出技嘉GIGAPOD兩年以來持續擴展產品組合，為自主代理式AI提供整合方案並簡化資源管理。
技鋼此次展出的管理機櫃解決方案整合了運算節點、交換器與伺服器，其中GIGABYTE G-REX將冷卻液分配裝置CDU、電源分配器PDU、後門熱交換器RDHx與漏液偵測管理整合至單一介面，並搭配UfiSpace提供用於東西向資料網路架構、AI訓練叢集與頻外管理的交換器，以及由合作夥伴VAST與WEKA為AI與高效能運算叢集提供超高速集中式儲存，讓資料更有效率地供應給GPU。
在高密度液冷CPU運算機櫃方面，技鋼展出全新6U液冷機箱刀鋒解決方案，可與CDU、PDU及冷熱水通道分歧管基礎設施整合，透過在CPU、記憶體與網卡上配置冷板，帶走近90%的系統熱量。
paras_en: GIGABYTE (2376‑TW) subsidiary TechSteel participated in Supercomputing 2026 held from November 17‑19 at McCormick Place in Chicago, USA, focusing on rack‑level infrastructure and autonomous agent AI at booth 2229. In line with the conference theme HPC Unites, TechSteel displayed integrated solutions for computing, liquid cooling, and partner ecosystems, offering a full product portfolio from lightweight personal AI supercomputers to rack‑level AI infrastructure.

With the rise of ultra‑large cloud providers and AI cloud service vendors, data center focus has shifted to large‑scale rack deployments. Since launching the GIGAPOD two years ago, TechSteel has continued to expand its product line, providing integrated solutions for autonomous agent AI and simplifying resource management.

The management rack solution showcased this time integrates compute nodes, switches, and servers. The G‑REX platform consolidates the liquid cooling distribution unit (CDU), power distribution unit (PDU), rear door heat exchanger (RDHx), and leak detection management into a single interface. It is paired with UfiSpace switches for east‑west data networking, AI training clusters, and out‑of‑band management, and with high‑speed centralized storage from partners VAST and WEKA for AI and HPC clusters, delivering data more efficiently to GPUs.

In the high‑density liquid‑cooled CPU rack segment, TechSteel presented a new 6U liquid‑cooled chassis blade solution that can integrate with CDU, PDU, and cold‑hot water manifold infrastructure. By installing cold plates on the CPU, memory, and network cards, it removes nearly 90% of system heat.

items.title: 亞太最大離岸風電拼明年Q1商轉！兆豐銀共同主辦海龍風場550億增額聯貸案
items.title_en: Asia-Pacific's Largest Offshore Wind Project Moves Toward Commercial Operation in Q1 2027! MegaBank Co-Hosts 55 Billion NTD Syndicated Loan for HaiLong Wind Farm
paras: 亞太地區大型離岸風電專案海龍離岸風電計畫正式完工併聯，兆豐金控 (2886-TW) 旗下兆豐銀行持續發揮大型專案融資專業，參與海龍離岸風電新台幣550億元增額聯貸案，並擔任共同主辦銀行暨國家融資保證管理銀行，該計畫於昨（17）日盛大舉行「海龍離岸風電計畫建置成果暨夥伴感恩典禮」，展現台灣推動綠能與政策金融的具體成果。
海龍計畫是由日商三井物產 (MITSUI & Co.) 、加拿大商北陸能源及馬來西亞商淨達力再生能源，為開發彰化外海離岸風場所共同成立的專案公司。該風場總裝置容量超過1GW，為目前亞太地區規模最大的單一離岸風電專案，預計將於2027年第1季正式商轉，為台灣能源轉型注入強勁且穩定的綠色電力動能。
本專案成功匯聚日本、加拿大及馬來西亞等跨國投資方共同支持，並透過國家融資保證機制有效擴大台灣國內金融機構的參與度，充分展現出台灣產業發展、政策金融支持與強化能源韌性的多元成果，也為後續大型再生能源專案建立跨國與公私協力的融資典範。
海龍計畫為支應專案興建開發資金需求，早於2023年便順利完成聯貸融資，隨著工程進度穩健推進、興建風險大幅降低，遂於2026年辦理融資架構調整並申請增額新台幣550億元。兆豐銀行不僅擔任共同主辦銀行及國家融資保證額度管理銀行，更憑藉豐富經驗扮演公股銀行團、財務顧問、融保中心與借款人間的溝通橋樑。
兆豐銀行全力響應政府淨零排放政策，積極投入離岸風電專案融資，除本案外，先前亦主辦中能發電聯貸案、擔任沃旭大彰化西南風場融保管理暨共同主辦銀行，並參與國泰風能、丹麥哥本哈根基礎建設基金之渢妙及海能風電聯貸；截至10月底，兆豐銀離岸風電融資餘額已逾250億元，持續提供可靠資金動能。
兆豐銀行在聯貸市場的卓越表現屢獲國際專業機構肯定，自2020年以來已四度榮獲亞太區貸款市場公會評選為「臺灣年度最佳聯貸銀行」；此外，根據倫敦證券交易所集團統計資料顯示，兆豐銀行在2026年前3季累計額度管理行承做聯貸業務排名高居第一，深受國內外金融機構及企業客戶的高度信賴。
paras_en: HaiLong Offshore Wind Project in the Asia-Pacific region has officially completed construction and is now linked, with MegaBank (2886-TW) continuing to leverage its expertise in large project financing by participating in a 55 billion NTD syndication for the HaiLong Offshore Wind Project and serving as the co-leading bank and national financing guarantee manager. The project held a grand “HaiLong Offshore Wind Project Construction Achievement and Partner Appreciation Ceremony” on the 17th, showcasing Taiwan’s concrete achievements in green energy and policy finance.

The HaiLong project is a joint venture established by Japan’s Mitsui & Co., Canada’s Northland Energy, and Malaysia’s NetPower Renewable Energy to develop an offshore wind site off Changhua. With a total installed capacity exceeding 1 GW, it is currently the largest single offshore wind project in the Asia-Pacific region and is expected to enter commercial operation in Q1 2027, injecting a strong and stable green power drive into Taiwan’s energy transition.

This project successfully brought together multinational investors from Japan, Canada, and Malaysia, and through the national financing guarantee mechanism effectively expanded participation from Taiwanese domestic financial institutions, fully demonstrating Taiwan’s industrial development, policy finance support, and enhanced energy resilience. It also establishes a cross‑border public‑private financing model for future large renewable energy projects.

To support the project’s construction and development financing needs, a syndication was successfully completed in 2023. As engineering progressed steadily and construction risks diminished, a financing structure adjustment was undertaken in 2026, and a 55 billion NTD increase was applied for. MegaBank not only served as the co‑leading bank and national financing guarantee manager but also leveraged its extensive experience to act as the bridge among the public‑sector bank consortium, financial advisors, the guarantee center, and the borrower.

MegaBank fully responds to the government’s net‑zero emissions policy, actively investing in offshore wind project financing. In addition to this case, it previously organized the Zhongnan Power Syndicated Loan, served as the guarantee manager and co‑leading bank for the Woxu Dazhanghua Southwest Wind Farm, and participated in the Cathay Wind, Copenhagen Infrastructure Fund’s Shimei, and Hainan Wind Syndicated Loans. By the end of October, MegaBank’s offshore wind financing balance exceeded 25 billion NTD, continuing to provide reliable financial momentum.

MegaBank’s outstanding performance in the syndicated loan market has been repeatedly recognized by international professional bodies. Since 2020, it has been named “Taiwan’s Best Syndicated Loan Bank” by the Asia‑Pacific Loan Market Association four times. Moreover, according to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, MegaBank ranked first in cumulative loan management for syndicated loan business in the first three quarters of 2026, earning high trust from domestic and international financial institutions and corporate clients.

items.title: 黃仁勳「長期副手」捲中國晶片走私疑雲！曾掌管重要客戶包括黃樂、疑與美超微涉案高層有關
items.title_en: Jay Puri, Nvidia’s Long‑Term Associate, Faces Allegations of China Chip Smuggling and Possible Links to SMCI‑US Executive
paras: 輝達前銷售主管、前執行長黃仁勳的長期副手 Jay Puri 遭做空機構及媒體接連指控，疑與中國企業規避美國出口管制、將輝達人工智慧（AI）晶片運入中國的案件有關，也被質疑與美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 涉嫌違規銷售伺服器至中國的高階主管存在關係。
根據《The Information》周二（17日）報導，Puri過去曾是輝達大型客戶的重要聯繫窗口，其中包括前Megaspeed執行長黃樂（Alice Huang）。
據悉，黃樂曾與一家中國企業合作，秘密將至少75億美元的輝達AI晶片輸入中國。知情人士指出，該中國企業透過這項進口安排，規避美國出口管制限制。
根據報導，黃樂曾與輝達共同創辦人、前執行長黃仁勳有交往關係，而黃仁勳上周在董事會施壓下離職，黃樂則被懷疑是中國間諜。
美國當局先前已對Megaspeed展開調查，懷疑該公司協助將輝達晶片運送給中國企業，涉嫌違反出口管制規定。
此外，Puri也被指控稱與伺服器製造商美超微有私人關係，該公司多名高階主管今年3月遭刑事起訴，罪名涉及涉嫌將輝達晶片轉運至中國。
《The Information》的報導發布數小時前，做空機構泥水基金（Muddy Waters）才剛對普里與美超微前高階主管Cenly Chen之間的關聯提出質疑，並表示已放空輝達股票。部分美超微股東指控，Chen可能協助將伺服器非法銷往中國。
這些指控與美國一宗刑事案件有關。美超微包括共同創辦人在內的3名員工遭到起訴，被控向中國客戶銷售價值數十億美元、搭載輝達晶片的伺服器。
Puri長期擔任輝達銷售主管，直到今年稍早離開該職位，目前仍以顧問身分與輝達保持合作關係。
如今，輝達面臨更嚴格的監管審查，外界關注其晶片是否透過不同管道流入中國。美國跨黨派議員已要求黃仁勳赴參議院銀行委員會作證。
根據《Politico》先前報導，黃仁勳已同意出席，並將在眾議院接受閉門聽證。
本周，美國也收緊中國取得輝達晶片的規定，堵住先前允許中國大型AI開發商透過設於海外的資料中心，取得輝達先進晶片的管道。
輝達財務長兼臨時執行長克雷斯（Colette Kress）周二表示，公司將停止向中國銷售Hopper系列資料中心晶片。
paras_en: Former Nvidia sales executive and ex‑CEO Jay Puri, a long‑time associate of Nvidia’s former chief executive Jensen Huang, has been repeatedly targeted by short‑selling firms and media for alleged involvement in a scheme to help Chinese companies evade U.S. export controls and ship Nvidia AI chips into China, and has also been accused of having ties to senior executives at server maker Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) who are alleged to have violated sales regulations by shipping servers to China.
According to a report by The Information on Tuesday (17th), Puri had previously served as a key contact for several large Nvidia customers, including former Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang.

It is reported that Alice Huang worked with a Chinese company to secretly import at least $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips into China. Sources say the Chinese company used this import arrangement to circumvent U.S. export‑control restrictions.

The report states that Alice Huang had a relationship with Nvidia co‑founder and former CEO Jensen Huang, and that Jensen Huang resigned last week under board pressure, while Alice Huang is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
U.S. authorities have already launched an investigation into Megaspeed, suspecting the company of assisting in the shipment of Nvidia chips to Chinese firms in violation of export‑control rules.

In addition, Puri has been accused of having a personal relationship with server manufacturer Super Micro, whose several senior executives were criminally charged in March of this year for allegedly routing Nvidia chips to China.

A few hours before The Information’s story was released, short‑seller Muddy Waters had just raised questions about the connection between Puri and former Super Micro executive Cenly Chen, and announced that it had shorted Nvidia shares. Some Super Micro shareholders allege that Chen may have helped illegally ship servers to China.

These allegations are tied to a U.S. criminal case. Three employees at Super Micro, including a co‑founder, have been indicted for selling servers equipped with Nvidia chips to Chinese customers worth billions of dollars.
Puri had been Nvidia’s sales chief for many years until he left the position earlier this year, and he remains in a consulting role with the company.

Today, Nvidia is facing stricter regulatory scrutiny, and observers are concerned about whether its chips are flowing into China through alternative channels. Bipartisan U.S. lawmakers have called on Jensen Huang to testify before the Senate Banking Committee.
According to a prior Politico report, Jensen Huang has agreed to appear and will also testify in a closed‑door hearing in the House of Representatives.

This week, the United States tightened rules governing China’s access to Nvidia chips, closing a previously allowed channel that let large Chinese AI developers obtain advanced Nvidia chips through overseas data centers.
Nvidia CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress said on Tuesday that the company will stop selling Hopper‑series data‑center chips to China.

items.title: 普丁出席APEC峰會發表演說 狠批歐盟並推進「去美元化」
items.title_en: Putin Attends APEC Summit, Delivers Speech, Harshly Criticizes EU and Advances ‘De‑Dollarisation’
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁周三(18日)飛抵中國深圳，出席亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)經濟領袖會議及其企業領袖峰會。他在開幕演說中強調，西方隔離俄羅斯的企圖已經失敗，俄國經濟展現出強大韌性，並公開宣示俄羅斯貿易中的「去美元化」取得顯著進展。
普丁在 APEC 企業領袖峰會發表演說時指出，儘管面臨多重國際制裁，俄羅斯仍尊嚴地克服各項挑戰，並正全力推進與亞太地區的互利合作。
他強調，全球經濟分化與地緣政治風險加劇之際，各國更需深化合作。俄方正積極擴展東部地區的物流與運輸能力，以強化與 APEC 成員國的經貿紐帶，並稱俄羅斯在數位轉型領域已具備領先地位。
在貿易結算與能源議題上，普丁明確表示，俄羅斯貿易結算中美元的所佔比例已急劇下降。同時，他對歐盟發動強烈批判，指出歐盟因失去俄羅斯廉價能源，正在喪失工業產能與市場競爭力，面臨高額債務及生活水準下降的窘境。
此外，普丁還向 APEC 成員國喊話，爭取支持俄羅斯於 2035 年再次主辦 APEC 峰會。
普丁在抵達當日即與中國國家主席習近平舉行會談，這是兩人於 2026 年內的第五次會晤。根據俄方數據，2026 年前 10 個月中國與俄羅斯的雙邊貿易額已達 2,425 億美元，年增近 33%，超越 2025 年全年總額，其中能源、石化與核能合作為重要支柱。
此行另一焦點為預計於 19 日登場的美中俄三方領袖峰會。美國總統川普在結束東南亞行程後轉赴深圳，白宮指出川普將在會中提出核裁軍議題；俄方外事顧問烏沙科夫則表示，會談將持續探討烏克蘭衝突的談判解決方案。
儘管俄方高調展示經濟活力，但外界分析指出，受高利率、通膨壓力及煉油產能下降等因素影響，俄國第三季 GDP 年增率已放緩至 1%。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen, China on Wednesday (the 18th) to attend the Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting and its Business Leaders’ Summit. In his opening remarks he stressed that the West’s attempt to isolate Russia has failed, the Russian economy has shown strong resilience, and he publicly declared that de‑dollarisation in Russian trade has made significant progress.

During his speech at the APEC Business Leaders’ Summit, Putin noted that despite facing multiple international sanctions, Russia has dignifiedly overcome various challenges and is fully pushing forward mutually beneficial cooperation with the Asia‑Pacific region.

He emphasized that as global economic fragmentation and geopolitical risks intensify, countries need deeper cooperation. Russia is actively expanding logistics and transport capacity in its eastern regions to strengthen trade ties with APEC members, and he claimed that Russia now holds a leading position in digital transformation.

On trade settlement and energy issues, Putin stated unequivocally that the share of the US dollar in Russian trade settlements has dropped sharply. He also launched a strong critique of the EU, pointing out that having lost cheap Russian energy, the EU is losing industrial capacity and market competitiveness, and is facing high debt and a decline in living standards.
Furthermore, Putin called on APEC member states to support Russia’s bid to host the APEC summit again in 2035.

On the day of his arrival, Putin held talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, marking their fifth meeting in 2026. According to Russian data, bilateral trade between China and Russia in the first ten months of 2026 reached $242.5 billion, up nearly 33% year‑on‑year and surpassing the total for all of 2025, with energy, petrochemicals and nuclear cooperation as key pillars.

Another focus of the trip was the trilateral leaders’ summit of the United States, China and Russia scheduled for the 19th. After concluding his Southeast Asia tour, U.S. President Donald Trump flew to Shenzhen; the White House said Trump will raise nuclear disarmament at the meeting, while Russian foreign policy adviser Ushakov said talks will continue to explore a negotiated settlement to the Ukraine conflict.

Although Russia is publicly showcasing economic vitality, external analysts note that high interest rates, inflation pressures and a decline in refining capacity have slowed Russia’s Q3 GDP annual growth rate to 1%.

items.title: 〈房產〉北捷站區周邊店租站點以東門站租金居冠 東區3站店租齊進前十大
items.title_en: East District Malls Near Taipei Metro Stations See Highest Store Rental Rates, with Dongmen Station Leading
paras: 捷運站周邊向來是業者拓展生意的重要選址考量， 房仲業者根據近一年的實價登錄租賃資料，統計台北捷運沿線各站點周邊800公尺內的店面租賃交易和租金行情。其中，東門站以平均單坪租金5,281元居首，西門站以4,500元居次。
至於榜單中店面租賃最熱絡的，是忠孝敦化站與國父紀念館站，近一年分別有44、27件的店面租賃，顯示在大巨蛋啟用後，吸引大量人流，也提升東區商消費動能。
數據顯示，近一年台北捷運店租最貴的站點是東門站。永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍指出，「東門站」為中和新蘆線與淡水信義線的雙捷交會站，周邊以永康商圈為核心，聚集不少特色餐飲、異國料理及伴手禮店家，加上聚集不少觀光客與在地消費人潮，帶動商圈店面需求，使租金行情維持高檔。
至於店租第二貴的西門站，陳金萍表示，「西門站」為板南線與松山新店線的雙捷交會站，交通便利且人流匯聚，為台北市每日進出站人次排名第二的站點。加上西門町是台北市重要的觀光與消費商圈，吸引大量年輕族群及國內外觀光客前往，具備穩定的消費人潮與商業活動。尤其商圈內以手搖飲、潮流服飾及特色餐飲等街邊店家為主，業者重視店面曝光度與人流效益，因此即使面對較高的租金成本，仍願意進駐具備地段優勢的店面。
陳金萍補充，東門站與西門站雖然商圈風格不同，但都具備明確的消費目的與商業聚集特色，顯示店面租金除了交通便利性，也與商圈辨識度、客群組成及消費需求密切相關。
進一步觀察這十大捷運站周邊店面租賃交易量，「忠孝敦化站」以44件排名第一，其次為「國父紀念館站」的27件。值得注意的是，國父紀念館、忠孝敦化及忠孝復興三站，合計租賃交易量達95件，顯示東區商圈周邊店面租賃交易規模有撐。

陳金萍分析，過去東區商圈曾面臨消費人潮轉移、店面空置等挑戰，不過隨著台北大巨蛋於2023年底啟用，陸續舉辦大型棒球賽事及演唱會，吸引大量人潮湧入，加上周邊商圈活化及步行環境改善，逐漸帶動東區商業活動回溫。尤其國父紀念館站鄰近大巨蛋、松山文創園區，除了日常通勤與在地消費人潮，也能承接賽事及展演活動帶來的觀光、休閒需求；忠孝敦化及忠孝復興站則串聯東區百貨、餐飲與特色零售商圈，形成更完整的消費生活圈，這三站近一年的店租約落在約4,000元，顯示店租行情仍處高檔。
陳金萍說， 根據台北市商業處統計，大巨蛋自2023年12月啟用至2026年9月底，累計吸引660.8萬人次入場，創造445億元經濟效益，其中帶動東區商圈消費32.1億元。未來隨著大巨蛋持續舉辦大型賽事及展演活動，加上東區商圈環境與商業機能逐步改善，有望進一步串聯國父紀念館、忠孝敦化及忠孝復興等站點，有機會延伸觀眾的停留時間，增加店家設點與經營的想像空間。
paras_en: The area around metro stations has long been a key consideration for businesses expanding their operations. Real estate agents analyzed the past year’s actual transaction data for rentals within 800 meters of Taipei Metro stations, compiling a list of store rental transactions and price trends. Dongmen Station topped the list with an average rent of 5,281 NTD per ping, followed by Ximen Station at 4,500 NTD per ping.

The most active rental market in the rankings was at Zhongxiao Dunhua Station and the National Father Memorial Hall Station, each with 44 and 27 store rentals respectively over the past year, indicating that the opening of the Taipei Dome has attracted large crowds and boosted commercial activity in the East District.

Data shows that Dongmen Station is the most expensive for Taipei Metro store rentals over the past year. Chen Jinping, assistant manager at Yongqing Real Estate Research Center, noted that Dongmen Station is a dual-line interchange between the Zhonghe-Xinlu and Tamsui-Xinyi lines, with the Yongkang business district at its core. The area hosts many specialty restaurants, international cuisine, and souvenir shops, drawing both tourists and local shoppers, which keeps rental prices high.

Regarding the second-highest rental rate at Ximen Station, Chen Jinping explained that Ximen Station is a dual-line interchange between the Bannan and Songshan-Xindian lines, offering convenient transport and high foot traffic. It ranks second in daily passenger volume in Taipei. Ximending is a major tourist and retail hub that attracts many young people and domestic and international visitors, providing a stable consumer flow and commercial activity. The area is dominated by street vendors selling bubble tea, trendy apparel, and specialty food, and businesses value storefront visibility and foot traffic, so they are willing to pay higher rents for prime locations.

Chen Jinping added that while Dongmen and Ximen stations have different commercial styles, both have clear consumer purposes and business cluster characteristics. This shows that store rental rates are closely related not only to transportation convenience but also to the district’s brand identity, customer composition, and consumption demand.

Further examining the top ten metro stations’ rental transaction volumes, Zhongxiao Dunhua Station led with 44 transactions, followed by National Father Memorial Hall Station with 27. Notably, the combined rental transactions for National Father Memorial Hall, Zhongxiao Dunhua, and Zhongxiao Fuxing stations total 95, indicating a strong rental market in the East District.

Chen Jinping analyzed that the East District had previously faced challenges such as shifting consumer crowds and vacant storefronts. However, since the Taipei Dome opened at the end of 2023 and has been hosting large baseball games and concerts, it has attracted massive crowds. Improvements in the surrounding business district and pedestrian environment have gradually revived commercial activity. National Father Memorial Hall Station, adjacent to the Dome and Songshan Cultural and Creative Park, serves daily commuters and local shoppers while also catering to tourism and leisure demand from events. Zhongxiao Dunhua and Zhongxiao Fuxing stations connect the East District’s department stores, dining, and specialty retail, forming a more complete consumer lifestyle circle. These three stations’ rental rates have hovered around 4,000 NTD per ping in the past year, indicating that the market remains premium.

Chen Jinping stated that according to Taipei City’s Commercial Office statistics, the Taipei Dome attracted 6.608 million visitors from its opening in December 2023 to the end of September 2026, generating 44.5 billion NTD in economic benefits, of which 3.21 billion NTD was driven by East District commerce. As the Dome continues to host large events and the East District’s environment and commercial functions improve, there is potential to further link National Father Memorial Hall, Zhongxiao Dunhua, and Zhongxiao Fuxing stations, extending audience dwell time and expanding opportunities for store placement and business imagination.

items.title: 美債殖利率攀升引爆華爾街論戰！高盛等機構看多 富達卻潑冷水：十年債殖利率飆到6%也不算便宜
items.title_en: Rising U.S. Treasury Yields Spark Wall Street Debate! Goldman Sachs and Others Bullish, Fidelity Dampens Hype: 10-Year Yield at 6% Still Not Cheap
paras: 美債市場持續承壓，殖利率不斷走高的同時，是否意味著買入機會已然浮現，正成為華爾街爭論的焦點。專家最新表示，即使美國10年債殖利率升至6%，也不足以斷言其估值已達極度便宜，此番謹慎觀點與高盛等看多機構形成鮮明對比。
富達國際全球宏觀及戰略資產配置主管Salman Ahmed表示，過去一週，受到美國通膨數據高於預期，以及Fed官員接連釋放偏鷹派信號影響，市場重新上調未來政策利率路徑，美債遭遇新一輪拋售。10年期殖利率一度升至5.12%左右，2年期達到4.86%。
雖然殖利率升高意味著新購債券可獲得更高利息回報，但富達認為，僅憑殖利率來到歷史較高水平，並不足以證明債券具有明顯投資價值。
Ahmed指出，富達的估值模型綜合考量殖利率曲線斜率、實質利率以及長期通膨水平等因素。在持續的通膨風險、不斷擴大的美國財政赤字，以及股債相關性發生變化的環境下，投資人需要重估長期美債的合理殖利率。即便10年債殖利率達到6%，在此框架下也不能稱其「極度便宜」。
目前，富達對美債各天期的久期配置總體保持中性，並強調美債對股市波動的對沖效果正在下降。在當前環境，股票和債券越來越可能同時下跌，這與美國財政赤字擴大、政府債務持續增加以及通膨更具持續性有關，因此即便債券票息收入較高，投資者仍可能因殖利率進一步上升而承受價格損失。
不同於富達的謹慎，高盛利率策略團隊預計，美國10年債殖利率可能從當前約5.1%的水平，在2027年底降至4.6%，判斷基礎在於未來通膨壓力逐漸緩和、Fed升息週期接近尾聲。
然而，T. Rowe Price等機構則對殖利率見頂持懷疑態度，警告若美國經濟未出現明顯衰退，美債殖利率恐難以形成持續性頂部。
近期市場表現凸顯上述矛盾。本月初，美國科技股因AI投資回報擔憂下跌時，美債一度受到避險資金追捧，但隨後通膨超預期，債市迅速轉跌，即便科技股繼續承壓，長期美債也未能持續發揮避險作用，顯示傳統的股債分散配置在通膨衝擊面前可能失效。
對長期債券投資者而言，能否獲得較高票息只是其一，更重要的是未來殖利率是否仍有大幅上行空間。
更值得關注的是美國官方干預風險。Ahmed指出，若美債殖利率快速逼近6%，美國政府恐被迫採取措施穩定市場，極端情況下甚至可能實施殖利率曲線控制(YCC)，也就是透過政策操作限制特定期限美債殖利率。
Ahmed預估此類極端情形的主觀機率約為25%至30%，而長債殖利率失控並迫使當局干預、進而強化貨幣貶值交易風險的概率約為20%至25%。
事實上，美國財長貝森特今年8月曾透過增加美債回購操作，試圖緩解長期融資成本上行壓力，但此舉一度引發市場對美元購買力與財政政策的擔憂。
所謂貨幣貶值交易，是指投資者擔心政府可能透過較寬鬆的金融條件減輕債務負擔，進而降低本幣及名義金融資產的實際購買力。
富達的謹慎立場並非要否定美債價值，而是強調傳統估值方法必須納入更高的通膨與財政風險溢價。
隨著美國債務規模膨脹與Fed政策預期反覆調整，市場需要判斷的不僅是美債殖利率能升多高，更在於這一殖利率是否足以補償未來可能發生的價格波動與政策風險。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market continues to be under pressure, and as yields rise, the question of whether buying opportunities have emerged has become a focal point of Wall Street debate. Experts now say that even if the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield climbs to 6%, it is not enough to conclude that its valuation is extremely cheap, a cautious view that sharply contrasts with the bullish stance of Goldman Sachs and others.

Fidelity International Global Macro and Strategic Asset Allocation head Salman Ahmed said that over the past week, higher-than‑expected U.S. inflation data and a string of hawkish signals from Fed officials pushed the market to raise its expectations for future policy rates, leading to a new round of Treasury selling. The 10‑year yield briefly rose to about 5.12%, while the 2‑year hit 4.86%.
Although higher yields mean new bonds can offer higher interest returns, Fidelity believes that simply reaching historically high levels is not enough to prove that bonds have clear investment value.

Ahmed pointed out that Fidelity’s valuation model takes into account the slope of the yield curve, real rates, and long‑term inflation levels. In an environment of persistent inflation risk, a widening U.S. fiscal deficit, and changing equity‑bond correlations, investors need to reassess the fair yield for long‑term Treasuries. Even if the 10‑year yield reaches 6%, it cannot be called "extremely cheap" under this framework.

Currently, Fidelity maintains a neutral stance on duration allocation across Treasury maturities and stresses that the hedging effect of Treasuries against stock market volatility is declining. In the current environment, stocks and bonds are increasingly likely to fall together, linked to a growing U.S. fiscal deficit, rising government debt, and more persistent inflation, so even with higher coupon income, investors may still suffer price losses as yields rise further.

Unlike Fidelity’s caution, Goldman Sachs’ rate strategy team expects the U.S. 10‑year yield to fall from its current level of about 5.1% to 4.6% by the end of 2027, based on easing inflation pressure and the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle nearing its end.

However, institutions such as T. Rowe Price remain skeptical about a peak in yields, warning that if the U.S. economy does not show clear signs of recession, Treasury yields may struggle to form a sustainable top.

Recent market performance highlighted this contradiction. Early this month, U.S. tech stocks fell amid concerns over AI investment returns, and Treasuries briefly benefited from safe‑haven flows, but after inflation surpassed expectations, the bond market quickly turned bearish. Even as tech stocks continued to be pressured, long‑term Treasuries failed to maintain a safe‑haven role, suggesting that traditional equity‑bond diversification may break down under inflationary shocks.
For long‑term bond investors, the ability to earn higher coupons is just one factor; the more important question is whether future yields still have significant upside potential.

A more concerning issue is the risk of U.S. official intervention. Ahmed noted that if Treasury yields rapidly approach 6%, the U.S. government may be forced to take measures to stabilize the market, and in extreme cases, could even implement yield‑curve control (YCC), i.e., policy actions that limit the yield on specific maturities.

Ahmed estimates the subjective probability of such an extreme scenario at about 25% to 30%, and the probability that long‑term yields spiral out of control, forcing intervention and thereby increasing the risk of currency‑devaluation trading, at about 20% to 25%.

In fact, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen in August this year increased Treasury repo operations to try to ease the upward pressure on long‑term financing costs, but this move temporarily raised concerns about dollar purchasing power and fiscal policy.

Currency‑devaluation trading refers to investors’ fears that the government may use looser financial conditions to ease debt burdens, thereby reducing the real purchasing power of the domestic currency and nominal financial assets.
Fidelity’s cautious stance does not deny the value of Treasuries; it simply emphasizes that traditional valuation methods must incorporate higher inflation and fiscal risk premiums.

As U.S. debt levels expand and Fed policy expectations shift repeatedly, the market must decide not only how high Treasury yields can rise, but also whether those yields are sufficient to compensate for potential future price volatility and policy risks.

items.title: 集邦：全球OLED螢幕Q3出貨年增翻倍 華碩穩坐龍頭、微星首次衝上第二
items.title_en: TrendForce: Global OLED Screen Shipments Double YoY in Q3, ASUS Remains Leader, MSI Rises to Second for First Time
paras: 根據集邦科技最新調查，2026年第三季全球OLED螢幕出貨動能強勁，單季出貨量季增13%，與2025年同期相比，更呈現翻倍躍升。市場成長主因除各大品牌持續推出新機、推升出貨規模外，上游面板供應充裕亦為關鍵助力，帶動二線、新進品牌的出貨量體顯著擴大，其中華碩(2357-TW)穩居出貨第一，微星(2377-TW)首次拿下市佔第二。
集邦科技表示，受各品牌布局策略與產品線調整影響，第三季OLED螢幕市場競爭激烈，出貨第二至第五名迎來大幅更動，反映出中段班品牌間的競爭已進入白熱化階段。
在群雄並起的態勢下，華碩以21.7%的市占率穩居全球出貨冠軍。受惠於27吋QHD 540Hz關鍵高階面板供應缺口順利回補，加上品牌20週年紀念款新機正式開賣拉動買氣，帶動其出貨量穩健季增6%。
微星第三季市占率較前季增加1.7個百分點，達14.5%，排名上升至全球第二名，前三季累計出貨表現與三星大致持平。微星第三季出貨成長動能主要來自27吋QHD機種迎來節慶檔期拉貨潮，加上27吋QHD 320Hz等多款新品相繼上市，提升整體季度出貨表現。
三星(005908-KS)今年第一至第三季出貨量維持穩定步調，但在整體市場規模迅速擴大的背景下，市占率遭到稀釋，第三季下滑至11.3%，排名退居全球第三。面對競爭壓力，三星在第四季將全面發力，鎖定歐美年底傳統購物節慶大舉衝刺出貨量，屆時有望重返市場第二名的位置。
樂金電子第三季針對旗下部分27吋QHD 240Hz機種祭出積極促銷方案，成功帶動買氣，推升其單季市占率達8.6%，排名前進一名，來到全球第四。
戴爾(DELL-US)第三季出貨表現回溫，單季市占率達8.2%，排名回升一名至全球第五。其成長動能主要來自27吋QHD 240Hz主流機種出貨規模持續放大，加上第二季上市的39吋新機在第三季加速放量，成功帶動整體出貨量能擴增。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest survey, global OLED screen shipments showed strong momentum in Q3 2026, with a quarter‑over‑quarter increase of 13% and a year‑over‑year jump that doubled the previous level. The market growth was driven not only by major brands continuously launching new devices and expanding shipment volumes, but also by ample upstream panel supply, which helped second‑tier and newcomer brands significantly expand their shipments. Among them, ASUS (2357‑TW) stayed at the top of shipments, while MSI (2377‑TW) claimed the second spot for the first time.

TrendForce noted that, due to brand positioning strategies and product‑line adjustments, competition in the OLED screen market intensified in the third quarter, causing large shifts among the second‑through‑fifth ranked manufacturers and indicating that rivalry among mid‑range brands has entered a fierce stage.

Amid the crowded field, ASUS held the global shipment lead with a 21.7% market share. Benefiting from the timely replenishment of a key high‑end 27‑inch QHD 540 Hz panel shortage and the launch of a 20‑year anniversary edition model that boosted demand, its shipments grew solidly by 6% quarter‑over‑quarter.

MSI’s Q3 market share rose by 1.7 percentage points to 14.5%, moving it up to the global second position, with its cumulative shipments for the first three quarters roughly matching Samsung’s. The growth momentum came mainly from a festive‑season surge in demand for its 27‑inch QHD models, as well as the rollout of several new products such as a 27‑inch QHD 320 Hz panel, which together lifted its quarterly shipment performance.

Samsung (005908‑KS) maintained a stable shipment pace from Q1 through Q3 this year, but its market share was diluted as the overall market expanded rapidly, slipping to 11.3% in Q3 and dropping to third place globally. Facing competitive pressure, Samsung plans to go all‑out in Q4, targeting the year‑end European and American shopping festivals to surge shipments and aim to reclaim the second‑largest market position.

LG Electronics launched aggressive promotions for some of its 27‑inch QHD 240 Hz models in Q3, successfully stimulating demand and raising its quarterly market share to 8.6%, moving up one rank to fourth place worldwide.

Dell (DELL‑US) saw its Q3 shipment performance rebound, achieving an 8.2% market share for the quarter and climbing one spot to fifth globally. Its growth was driven by continued expansion of its mainstream 27‑inch QHD 240 Hz models and the accelerated volume ramp‑up of a new 39‑inch model introduced in Q2, which together boosted overall shipment capacity.

items.title: 技嘉旗下技鋼參展SC26 大秀GIGAPOD與高密度液冷機櫃
items.title_en: GIGABYTE’s TechSteel Showcases GIGAPOD and High-Density Liquid-Cooled Racks at SC26
paras: 技嘉(2376-TW)旗下技鋼科技參與11月17日至19日在美國芝加哥McCormick Place舉行的Supercomputing 2026，於展位2229聚焦機櫃級基礎架構與自主代理式AI。呼應大會HPC Unites主題，技鋼在現場展示運算、液冷與夥伴生態系的整合方案，完整產品組合涵蓋從輕巧的個人AI超級電腦到機櫃級AI基礎架構。
隨著超大規模雲端業者與AI雲端服務供應商崛起，資料中心重心已轉向大規模機櫃級部署，技鋼自推出技嘉GIGAPOD兩年以來持續擴展產品組合，為自主代理式AI提供整合方案並簡化資源管理。
技鋼此次展出的管理機櫃解決方案整合了運算節點、交換器與伺服器，其中GIGABYTE G-REX將冷卻液分配裝置CDU、電源分配器PDU、後門熱交換器RDHx與漏液偵測管理整合至單一介面，並搭配UfiSpace提供用於東西向資料網路架構、AI訓練叢集與頻外管理的交換器，以及由合作夥伴VAST與WEKA為AI與高效能運算叢集提供超高速集中式儲存，讓資料更有效率地供應給GPU。
在高密度液冷CPU運算機櫃方面，技鋼展出全新6U液冷機箱刀鋒解決方案，可與CDU、PDU及冷熱水通道分歧管基礎設施整合，透過在CPU、記憶體與網卡上配置冷板，帶走近90%的系統熱量。
paras_en: GIGABYTE (2376‑TW) subsidiary TechSteel participated in Supercomputing 2026 held from November 17‑19 at McCormick Place in Chicago, USA, focusing on rack‑level infrastructure and autonomous agent AI at booth 2229. In line with the conference theme HPC Unites, TechSteel displayed integrated solutions for computing, liquid cooling, and partner ecosystems, offering a full product portfolio from lightweight personal AI supercomputers to rack‑level AI infrastructure.

With the rise of ultra‑large cloud providers and AI cloud service vendors, data center focus has shifted to large‑scale rack deployments. Since launching the GIGAPOD two years ago, TechSteel has continued to expand its product line, providing integrated solutions for autonomous agent AI and simplifying resource management.

The management rack solution showcased this time integrates compute nodes, switches, and servers. The G‑REX platform consolidates the liquid cooling distribution unit (CDU), power distribution unit (PDU), rear door heat exchanger (RDHx), and leak detection management into a single interface. It is paired with UfiSpace switches for east‑west data networking, AI training clusters, and out‑of‑band management, and with high‑speed centralized storage from partners VAST and WEKA for AI and HPC clusters, delivering data more efficiently to GPUs.

In the high‑density liquid‑cooled CPU rack segment, TechSteel presented a new 6U liquid‑cooled chassis blade solution that can integrate with CDU, PDU, and cold‑hot water manifold infrastructure. By installing cold plates on the CPU, memory, and network cards, it removes nearly 90% of system heat.

items.title: 亞太最大離岸風電拼明年Q1商轉！兆豐銀共同主辦海龍風場550億增額聯貸案
items.title_en: Asia-Pacific's Largest Offshore Wind Project Moves Toward Commercial Operation in Q1 2027! MegaBank Co-Hosts 55 Billion NTD Syndicated Loan for HaiLong Wind Farm
paras: 亞太地區大型離岸風電專案海龍離岸風電計畫正式完工併聯，兆豐金控 (2886-TW) 旗下兆豐銀行持續發揮大型專案融資專業，參與海龍離岸風電新台幣550億元增額聯貸案，並擔任共同主辦銀行暨國家融資保證管理銀行，該計畫於昨（17）日盛大舉行「海龍離岸風電計畫建置成果暨夥伴感恩典禮」，展現台灣推動綠能與政策金融的具體成果。
海龍計畫是由日商三井物產 (MITSUI & Co.) 、加拿大商北陸能源及馬來西亞商淨達力再生能源，為開發彰化外海離岸風場所共同成立的專案公司。該風場總裝置容量超過1GW，為目前亞太地區規模最大的單一離岸風電專案，預計將於2027年第1季正式商轉，為台灣能源轉型注入強勁且穩定的綠色電力動能。
本專案成功匯聚日本、加拿大及馬來西亞等跨國投資方共同支持，並透過國家融資保證機制有效擴大台灣國內金融機構的參與度，充分展現出台灣產業發展、政策金融支持與強化能源韌性的多元成果，也為後續大型再生能源專案建立跨國與公私協力的融資典範。
海龍計畫為支應專案興建開發資金需求，早於2023年便順利完成聯貸融資，隨著工程進度穩健推進、興建風險大幅降低，遂於2026年辦理融資架構調整並申請增額新台幣550億元。兆豐銀行不僅擔任共同主辦銀行及國家融資保證額度管理銀行，更憑藉豐富經驗扮演公股銀行團、財務顧問、融保中心與借款人間的溝通橋樑。
兆豐銀行全力響應政府淨零排放政策，積極投入離岸風電專案融資，除本案外，先前亦主辦中能發電聯貸案、擔任沃旭大彰化西南風場融保管理暨共同主辦銀行，並參與國泰風能、丹麥哥本哈根基礎建設基金之渢妙及海能風電聯貸；截至10月底，兆豐銀離岸風電融資餘額已逾250億元，持續提供可靠資金動能。
兆豐銀行在聯貸市場的卓越表現屢獲國際專業機構肯定，自2020年以來已四度榮獲亞太區貸款市場公會評選為「臺灣年度最佳聯貸銀行」；此外，根據倫敦證券交易所集團統計資料顯示，兆豐銀行在2026年前3季累計額度管理行承做聯貸業務排名高居第一，深受國內外金融機構及企業客戶的高度信賴。
paras_en: HaiLong Offshore Wind Project in the Asia-Pacific region has officially completed construction and is now linked, with MegaBank (2886-TW) continuing to leverage its expertise in large project financing by participating in a 55 billion NTD syndication for the HaiLong Offshore Wind Project and serving as the co-leading bank and national financing guarantee manager. The project held a grand “HaiLong Offshore Wind Project Construction Achievement and Partner Appreciation Ceremony” on the 17th, showcasing Taiwan’s concrete achievements in green energy and policy finance.

The HaiLong project is a joint venture established by Japan’s Mitsui & Co., Canada’s Northland Energy, and Malaysia’s NetPower Renewable Energy to develop an offshore wind site off Changhua. With a total installed capacity exceeding 1 GW, it is currently the largest single offshore wind project in the Asia-Pacific region and is expected to enter commercial operation in Q1 2027, injecting a strong and stable green power drive into Taiwan’s energy transition.

This project successfully brought together multinational investors from Japan, Canada, and Malaysia, and through the national financing guarantee mechanism effectively expanded participation from Taiwanese domestic financial institutions, fully demonstrating Taiwan’s industrial development, policy finance support, and enhanced energy resilience. It also establishes a cross‑border public‑private financing model for future large renewable energy projects.

To support the project’s construction and development financing needs, a syndication was successfully completed in 2023. As engineering progressed steadily and construction risks diminished, a financing structure adjustment was undertaken in 2026, and a 55 billion NTD increase was applied for. MegaBank not only served as the co‑leading bank and national financing guarantee manager but also leveraged its extensive experience to act as the bridge among the public‑sector bank consortium, financial advisors, the guarantee center, and the borrower.

MegaBank fully responds to the government’s net‑zero emissions policy, actively investing in offshore wind project financing. In addition to this case, it previously organized the Zhongnan Power Syndicated Loan, served as the guarantee manager and co‑leading bank for the Woxu Dazhanghua Southwest Wind Farm, and participated in the Cathay Wind, Copenhagen Infrastructure Fund’s Shimei, and Hainan Wind Syndicated Loans. By the end of October, MegaBank’s offshore wind financing balance exceeded 25 billion NTD, continuing to provide reliable financial momentum.

MegaBank’s outstanding performance in the syndicated loan market has been repeatedly recognized by international professional bodies. Since 2020, it has been named “Taiwan’s Best Syndicated Loan Bank” by the Asia‑Pacific Loan Market Association four times. Moreover, according to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, MegaBank ranked first in cumulative loan management for syndicated loan business in the first three quarters of 2026, earning high trust from domestic and international financial institutions and corporate clients.

items.title: 〈房產〉北捷站區周邊店租站點以東門站租金居冠 東區3站店租齊進前十大
items.title_en: East District Malls Near Taipei Metro Stations See Highest Store Rental Rates, with Dongmen Station Leading
paras: 捷運站周邊向來是業者拓展生意的重要選址考量， 房仲業者根據近一年的實價登錄租賃資料，統計台北捷運沿線各站點周邊800公尺內的店面租賃交易和租金行情。其中，東門站以平均單坪租金5,281元居首，西門站以4,500元居次。
至於榜單中店面租賃最熱絡的，是忠孝敦化站與國父紀念館站，近一年分別有44、27件的店面租賃，顯示在大巨蛋啟用後，吸引大量人流，也提升東區商消費動能。
數據顯示，近一年台北捷運店租最貴的站點是東門站。永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍指出，「東門站」為中和新蘆線與淡水信義線的雙捷交會站，周邊以永康商圈為核心，聚集不少特色餐飲、異國料理及伴手禮店家，加上聚集不少觀光客與在地消費人潮，帶動商圈店面需求，使租金行情維持高檔。
至於店租第二貴的西門站，陳金萍表示，「西門站」為板南線與松山新店線的雙捷交會站，交通便利且人流匯聚，為台北市每日進出站人次排名第二的站點。加上西門町是台北市重要的觀光與消費商圈，吸引大量年輕族群及國內外觀光客前往，具備穩定的消費人潮與商業活動。尤其商圈內以手搖飲、潮流服飾及特色餐飲等街邊店家為主，業者重視店面曝光度與人流效益，因此即使面對較高的租金成本，仍願意進駐具備地段優勢的店面。
陳金萍補充，東門站與西門站雖然商圈風格不同，但都具備明確的消費目的與商業聚集特色，顯示店面租金除了交通便利性，也與商圈辨識度、客群組成及消費需求密切相關。
進一步觀察這十大捷運站周邊店面租賃交易量，「忠孝敦化站」以44件排名第一，其次為「國父紀念館站」的27件。值得注意的是，國父紀念館、忠孝敦化及忠孝復興三站，合計租賃交易量達95件，顯示東區商圈周邊店面租賃交易規模有撐。

陳金萍分析，過去東區商圈曾面臨消費人潮轉移、店面空置等挑戰，不過隨著台北大巨蛋於2023年底啟用，陸續舉辦大型棒球賽事及演唱會，吸引大量人潮湧入，加上周邊商圈活化及步行環境改善，逐漸帶動東區商業活動回溫。尤其國父紀念館站鄰近大巨蛋、松山文創園區，除了日常通勤與在地消費人潮，也能承接賽事及展演活動帶來的觀光、休閒需求；忠孝敦化及忠孝復興站則串聯東區百貨、餐飲與特色零售商圈，形成更完整的消費生活圈，這三站近一年的店租約落在約4,000元，顯示店租行情仍處高檔。
陳金萍說， 根據台北市商業處統計，大巨蛋自2023年12月啟用至2026年9月底，累計吸引660.8萬人次入場，創造445億元經濟效益，其中帶動東區商圈消費32.1億元。未來隨著大巨蛋持續舉辦大型賽事及展演活動，加上東區商圈環境與商業機能逐步改善，有望進一步串聯國父紀念館、忠孝敦化及忠孝復興等站點，有機會延伸觀眾的停留時間，增加店家設點與經營的想像空間。
paras_en: The area around metro stations has long been a key consideration for businesses expanding their operations. Real estate agents analyzed the past year’s actual transaction data for rentals within 800 meters of Taipei Metro stations, compiling a list of store rental transactions and price trends. Dongmen Station topped the list with an average rent of 5,281 NTD per ping, followed by Ximen Station at 4,500 NTD per ping.

The most active rental market in the rankings was at Zhongxiao Dunhua Station and the National Father Memorial Hall Station, each with 44 and 27 store rentals respectively over the past year, indicating that the opening of the Taipei Dome has attracted large crowds and boosted commercial activity in the East District.

Data shows that Dongmen Station is the most expensive for Taipei Metro store rentals over the past year. Chen Jinping, assistant manager at Yongqing Real Estate Research Center, noted that Dongmen Station is a dual-line interchange between the Zhonghe-Xinlu and Tamsui-Xinyi lines, with the Yongkang business district at its core. The area hosts many specialty restaurants, international cuisine, and souvenir shops, drawing both tourists and local shoppers, which keeps rental prices high.

Regarding the second-highest rental rate at Ximen Station, Chen Jinping explained that Ximen Station is a dual-line interchange between the Bannan and Songshan-Xindian lines, offering convenient transport and high foot traffic. It ranks second in daily passenger volume in Taipei. Ximending is a major tourist and retail hub that attracts many young people and domestic and international visitors, providing a stable consumer flow and commercial activity. The area is dominated by street vendors selling bubble tea, trendy apparel, and specialty food, and businesses value storefront visibility and foot traffic, so they are willing to pay higher rents for prime locations.

Chen Jinping added that while Dongmen and Ximen stations have different commercial styles, both have clear consumer purposes and business cluster characteristics. This shows that store rental rates are closely related not only to transportation convenience but also to the district’s brand identity, customer composition, and consumption demand.

Further examining the top ten metro stations’ rental transaction volumes, Zhongxiao Dunhua Station led with 44 transactions, followed by National Father Memorial Hall Station with 27. Notably, the combined rental transactions for National Father Memorial Hall, Zhongxiao Dunhua, and Zhongxiao Fuxing stations total 95, indicating a strong rental market in the East District.

Chen Jinping analyzed that the East District had previously faced challenges such as shifting consumer crowds and vacant storefronts. However, since the Taipei Dome opened at the end of 2023 and has been hosting large baseball games and concerts, it has attracted massive crowds. Improvements in the surrounding business district and pedestrian environment have gradually revived commercial activity. National Father Memorial Hall Station, adjacent to the Dome and Songshan Cultural and Creative Park, serves daily commuters and local shoppers while also catering to tourism and leisure demand from events. Zhongxiao Dunhua and Zhongxiao Fuxing stations connect the East District’s department stores, dining, and specialty retail, forming a more complete consumer lifestyle circle. These three stations’ rental rates have hovered around 4,000 NTD per ping in the past year, indicating that the market remains premium.

Chen Jinping stated that according to Taipei City’s Commercial Office statistics, the Taipei Dome attracted 6.608 million visitors from its opening in December 2023 to the end of September 2026, generating 44.5 billion NTD in economic benefits, of which 3.21 billion NTD was driven by East District commerce. As the Dome continues to host large events and the East District’s environment and commercial functions improve, there is potential to further link National Father Memorial Hall, Zhongxiao Dunhua, and Zhongxiao Fuxing stations, extending audience dwell time and expanding opportunities for store placement and business imagination.

items.title: 不畏大盤下修5.69%  10月ETF大洗牌！主動式台股ETF逆勢暴增538億奪冠
items.title_en: Unfazed by a 5.69% Market Decline: October ETF Shakeup! Active Taiwan Stock ETFs Surge 53.8 Billion to Take the Lead
paras: 儘管台股10月震盪加劇，台灣加權股價指數單月下跌5.69%，從47940.13點滑落至45211.83點，但台股ETF投資人並未全面撤退，反而愈跌愈買。根據投信投顧公會最新統計，10月主動式台股ETF規模逆勢由8267.56億元成長至8806.35億元，單月大增538.8億元、增幅高達6.52%，表現居表列各類主被動ETF之冠，顯示在盤勢劇烈波動下，「主動管理＋分散配置」正成為市場應戰兩大關鍵字。

觀察10月境內主被動ETF規模變化，資金動能出現明顯分化。投信投顧公會數據顯示，市場愈震盪，投資人對主動管理的需求反而升高，相較於主動式台股ETF大增6.52%，同期被動式台股ETF規模雖由6.71兆元微幅增至6.74兆元，但單月增幅僅0.45%。此外，主動式跨國股票ETF規模則由1432.16億元縮水至1237.27億元，單月減幅達13.61%，反映資金在大盤回檔之際，正積極汰弱留強並調整配置重心。
資料來源：投信投顧公會，2026年11月13日
除了主動式台股ETF表現亮眼，債券ETF也是10月另一個明顯成長的類別，展現資金透過多元資產分散風險的趨勢。統計指出，被動式跨國債券ETF規模由9月的2.7兆元增加至10月的2.83兆元，單月吸金約1300億元、成長幅度達4.81%，增幅在各類產品中僅次於主動式台股ETF；同時，主動式跨國債券ETF規模也從247.58億元小幅攀升至248.35億元，單月微增0.32%，整體債券部位買氣穩健增溫。
從全球市場表現來看，摩根資產管理指出，當AI投資敘事進入重新定價階段，全球股市已出現顯著分化，資金配置也趨向靈活。根據彭博資訊以美元計價統計，自10月6日至11月13日期間，韓國股市重挫31.2%、費城半導體指數修正30.27%，台股亦回檔14.06%；然而同一期間，歐洲STOXX 600指數卻逆勢上漲4.14%，證明在全球投資題材多元之下並非全盤皆墨，仍有市場能夠異軍突起。

針對歐股逆勢抗跌的原因，主動摩根歐洲鑫收 (00422A-TW) 產品經理黃百嵩分析，台股自10月6日創下波段新高後隨即進入修正，但同期歐股逆勢上揚，日股修正幅度也不到台股一半。本波震盪主要集中於AI與高估值科技股，市場開始重新檢視龐大AI資本支出的投資回報，使科技股占比較高的市場承壓；反觀歐洲偏重金融、能源、工業與醫療等價值型產業，在資金由成長轉向價值的輪動下展現較佳韌性，更突顯跨市場分散配置的重要性。
摩根資產管理總結，無論從近期台灣境內ETF資金流向，或是歐美亞主要股市的表現分化來看，皆顯示金融市場已由過去的「單一主題領漲」，逐步邁入「多元機會並存」的新階段。雖然AI仍是值得關注的重要長期趨勢，但面對高檔震盪加劇的環境，投資人更需要仰賴主動管理策略，在市場修正後精準發掘具吸引力的投資機會，並透過跨市場、跨資產的多元布局，有效降低單一市場與產業的集中風險。
paras_en: Despite the intensified volatility in Taiwan’s stock market in October, the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 5.69% in the month, sliding from 47,940.13 to 45,211.83 points, yet ETF investors did not retreat wholesale; instead, they bought more as prices fell. According to the latest statistics from the Association of Investment Trusts and Financial Advisors, the size of active Taiwan stock ETFs rose against the trend from 826.756 billion to 880.635 billion, a monthly increase of 53.88 billion and a growth rate of 6.52%, topping all other active and passive ETF categories and showing that “active management + diversified allocation” has become the two key words for navigating volatile markets.

Observing the changes in domestic active and passive ETF sizes in October, a clear divergence in capital momentum emerged. The Association’s data shows that as the market volatility increased, investors’ demand for active management actually rose. Compared with the 6.52% jump in active Taiwan stock ETFs, the passive Taiwan stock ETF size only rose slightly from 6.71 trillion to 6.74 trillion, a monthly growth of just 0.45%. In contrast, the size of active cross‑border equity ETFs shrank from 143.216 billion to 123.727 billion, a monthly decline of 13.61%, reflecting a shift toward pruning weak holdings and reallocating focus as the market retraced.
Source: Association of Investment Trusts and Financial Advisors, November 13, 2026

Besides the strong performance of active Taiwan stock ETFs, bond ETFs were another category that saw significant growth in October, demonstrating a trend of risk diversification across multiple asset classes. Statistics show that the size of passive cross‑border bond ETFs increased from 2.7 trillion in September to 2.83 trillion in October, attracting about 130 billion in new capital and growing 4.81%, second only to active Taiwan stock ETFs among all product categories. Meanwhile, the size of active cross‑border bond ETFs rose modestly from 24.758 billion to 24.835 billion, a monthly increase of 0.32%, indicating steady buying momentum in the bond segment.

From a global market perspective, Morgan Asset Management noted that as the AI investment narrative enters a re‑pricing phase, global equities have shown significant divergence and capital allocation has become more flexible. Bloomberg data in USD shows that from October 6 to November 13, the Korean market fell 31.2%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index corrected 30.27%, and Taiwan’s market also retraced 14.06%; however, during the same period the European STOXX 600 index rose 4.14% against the trend, proving that under diverse global investment themes not all markets are down, and some can still rise.

Regarding the reasons for European stocks’ resilience, Morgan Europe’s product manager Huang Baizong of the active Morgan Europe XIN (00422A‑TW) explained that after Taiwan hit a new swing high on October 6, it immediately entered a correction, while European stocks rose against the trend and Japan’s correction was less than half that of Taiwan. This wave of volatility is mainly concentrated in AI and high‑valuation tech stocks, as the market begins to reassess the return on massive AI capital expenditures, putting pressure on tech‑heavy markets. In contrast, Europe’s focus on value sectors such as finance, energy, industry, and healthcare, coupled with a shift from growth to value, has shown greater resilience, highlighting the importance of cross‑market diversification.

Morgan Asset Management concluded that whether looking at recent ETF capital flows in Taiwan or the divergent performance of major markets in Europe, America, and Asia, the financial market has moved from a past “single‑theme rally” to a new phase of “multiple opportunities coexisting.” While AI remains an important long‑term trend, in an environment of heightened high‑frequency volatility, investors need to rely on active management strategies to accurately identify attractive opportunities after market corrections and, through cross‑market and cross‑asset diversification, effectively reduce concentration risk in any single market or industry.

items.title: 波蘭TEEMA產業日吸引逾千位國際買主參展 電電公會估：帶動2千萬美元採購商機
items.title_en: Poland TEEMA Industry Day Attracts Over 1,000 International Buyers, Estimated to Drive $20 Million in Procurement Opportunities
paras: 2026年TEEMA科學園區產業日-波蘭」今(18)日在波蘭華沙落幕，電電公會今(18)日表示，此次透過產業展示、論壇交流及㇐對㇐商務媒合，展現台灣從關鍵零組件、設備製造到系統整合的供應鏈實力，2天活動共吸引逾500 家企業、近千位國際買主參觀展覽及參與論壇，促成超過百場㇐對㇐商機媒合，估計帶動2,000萬美元潛在採購商機，也協助台灣業者拓展中東歐市場。
此次活動由經濟部指導，國貿署及電電公會(TEEMA)主辦，集結ICT 、工具機、電動車及智慧醫療等領域逾30 家台灣廠商參展。
經濟部⾧龔明鑫表示，台灣在ICT、AI、智慧製造及電動車等領域具備完整供應鏈優勢，與波蘭產業發展需求高度互補，波蘭是台灣企業拓展中東歐市場的重要據點，經濟部將持續整合政府與產業資源，促進雙方在技術、投資及供應鏈方面的實質合作。
電電公會副理事⾧許介立於表示，因應地緣政治變化與全球供應鏈重組，台灣企業正加速全球布局，電電公會於波蘭下西里西亞省弗羅茨瓦夫(Wrocław)近郊的米恩基尼亞規劃TEEMA 科學園區，總面積約150 公頃，將聚焦AI 資料中心、電動車、無人機及智慧城市等產業。
許介立也宣布，園區將率先啟動首期50 公頃開發，作為建立台波⾧期產業夥伴關係的第㇐步，後續再分期擴展，期盼能盡速進行相關開發作業。
此次台灣方面由許介立率團，包括鴻海(2317-TW)科技集團、東元(1504-TW)電機、環電、旭東機械、行競科技、勤崴國際(6516-TW)科技、永進機械及亞崴機電等業者，並集結重要工協會，包含機械公會、工具機公會及台灣電路板協會等，共同展示AI 資料中心機櫃、模組化資料中心、液冷技術、電動車及動力系統、智慧移動及精密加工設備等技術與應用。
由金屬工業研究發展中心率領廠商共同展出的智慧醫療主題館，則呈現智慧診斷、醫療資料分析、健康照護及醫療影像等創新應用，展現台灣科技產業跨領域整合的優勢。
電電公會表示，商機媒合是本次活動的重要成果，主辦單位依據買主需求與台灣廠商專⾧，安排㇐對㇐商務洽談，2天共吸引450 家國際買家與30 家台灣廠商參與，完成182 場媒合，洽談內容涵蓋系統整合與專案合作、零組件採購及供應鏈布局等內容，衍生採購商機達2,000 萬美元。
許介立表示，此次活動結合產業展示、論壇交流及商機媒合，讓台廠直接接觸當地買主及合作夥伴，活動模式獲得良好成效，未來公會將持續辦理系列活動，協助台灣企業開拓海外商機、配合TEEMA 科學園區推動，攜手台灣業者加快國際市場布局。
paras_en: The 2026 TEEMA Science Park Industry Day in Poland concluded in Warsaw on the 18th, with the Electrical and Electronic Association (TEEMA) reporting that the event showcased Taiwan’s supply chain strength from critical components and equipment manufacturing to system integration through industry displays, forums, and one‑to‑one business matchmaking. Over 500 companies and nearly a thousand international buyers visited the exhibition and participated in the forums, resulting in more than a hundred one‑to‑one matchmaking opportunities and an estimated $20 million in potential procurement opportunities, helping Taiwanese firms expand into the Middle East and Eastern European markets.

The event, guided by the Ministry of Economic Affairs, was organized by the National Trade Administration and TEEMA, bringing together more than 30 Taiwanese exhibitors from ICT, machine tools, electric vehicles, and smart medical sectors.

Minister of Economic Affairs Long Gongmingxin stated that Taiwan possesses a complete supply chain advantage in ICT, AI, smart manufacturing, and electric vehicles, which highly complements Poland’s industrial development needs. Poland is an important hub for Taiwanese companies to expand into the Middle East and Eastern Europe, and the Ministry will continue to integrate government and industry resources to promote substantial cooperation in technology, investment, and supply chain between the two sides.

TEEMA Vice Chairman Long Xiu‑li said that in response to geopolitical changes and global supply chain restructuring, Taiwanese companies are accelerating global expansion. TEEMA plans a science park in Mienkiniy, near Wrocław in the Lower Silesian Province, covering about 150 hectares, focusing on AI data centers, electric vehicles, drones, and smart cities.

Long announced that the park will launch the first phase of 50 hectares as the initial step to establish long‑term industry partnerships between Taiwan and Poland, with subsequent phased expansions to expedite related development work.

The Taiwanese delegation led by Long included companies such as Foxconn (2317‑TW), TECO Electric (1504‑TW), Huan‑Dian, Xudong Machinery, Xingjing Technology, Qunwei International (6516‑TW), Yongjin Machinery, and Yawai Electromechanical, along with key industry associations including the Mechanical Association, Machine Tool Association, and Taiwan PCB Association. They showcased AI data center cabinets, modular data centers, liquid cooling technology, electric vehicle and power systems, smart mobility, and precision machining equipment.

A smart medical theme hall, led by the Metal Industry Research and Development Center and participating manufacturers, presented innovations in smart diagnostics, medical data analysis, health care, and medical imaging, demonstrating Taiwan’s cross‑disciplinary integration advantage in the tech industry.

TEEMA noted that business matchmaking was a key outcome of the event. Based on buyer needs and Taiwanese manufacturers’ specialties, the organizers arranged one‑to‑one business talks. Over two days, 450 international buyers and 30 Taiwanese companies participated, completing 182 matchmaking sessions covering system integration, project collaboration, component procurement, and supply chain layout, generating $20 million in procurement opportunities.

Long said that combining industry displays, forum exchanges, and business matchmaking allowed Taiwanese firms to directly engage local buyers and partners. The event model proved effective, and TEEMA will continue to hold a series of activities to help Taiwanese companies tap overseas opportunities and support the promotion of the TEEMA Science Park, working together with Taiwanese firms to accelerate international market expansion.

items.title: 800萬筆個資外洩拉警報！政院促十餘家「受駭」企業主動通知民眾
items.title_en: 800,000 Personal Data Breaches Trigger Alert! Executive Yuan Urges Over Ten Hacked Companies to Notify the Public
paras: 近期台灣爆發多起重大資訊安全事件，行政院今（18）日要求各部會督促所轄發生個資外洩的企業與機構，立即依個人資料保護法規定通知受影響當事人，並呼籲全體國民提高警覺，防範詐騙集團假冒客服或檢警，或發送釣魚電子郵件與簡訊行騙，共同守護個人財產安全。
根據數位發展部統計資料顯示，近期國內已有10餘家企業及機構爆發重大資安事件，累計外洩的個人資料高達約800萬筆，受波及範圍相當廣泛。面對嚴峻的資安威脅與衍生風險，政府已正式啟動跨部會督導機制，要求相關主管機關緊盯業者落實法遵，避免外洩情事持續擴大並降低對社會大眾的衝擊。
針對具體通報作法，行政院已發函請相關部會督促所涉企業與機構，必須切實依照個人資料保護法第12條及施行細則第22條規定，即時以言詞、書面、電話、簡訊、電子郵件、傳真、電子文件或其他多元方式通知資料被外洩當事人，確保民眾在第一時間掌握自身權益受損狀況並提早防備。
為了擴大警示效果，行政院同時建議各受災企業與機構，除了個別通知受害者之外，更應在官方網站首頁、行動應用程式APP或實體店面等顯眼處張貼醒目公告，具體且明確地提醒民眾可能面臨的詐騙手法與潛在風險，透過公開透明的資訊揭露，協助消費者建立防詐意識並降低資訊落差。
行政院打擊詐欺指揮中心再次提醒民眾千萬要提高警覺，就算詐騙集團輕易說出你的身分證字號、出生年月日、住址等個資也不要驚慌，切勿被詐騙集團話術帶著走，應立刻掛斷電話並撥打165反詐騙專線求證，同時隨時注意企業機構官網首頁、APP或實體店面公告，確保個人財產安全無虞。
paras_en: Recently, Taiwan has experienced several major information security incidents. On the 18th, the Executive Yuan instructed all ministries to urge companies and institutions that have suffered personal data breaches to immediately notify affected individuals in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act, and called on all citizens to stay alert against fraud groups posing as customer service or police, or sending phishing emails and text messages, to jointly safeguard personal financial security.

According to statistics from the Ministry of Digital Development, more than ten domestic enterprises and institutions have recently suffered major cybersecurity incidents, with a cumulative leakage of approximately 8 million personal data records, affecting a wide range of individuals. Facing severe security threats and derived risks, the government has officially launched a cross-ministerial supervisory mechanism, requiring relevant authorities to closely monitor businesses to ensure compliance with the law, prevent further expansion of breaches, and reduce the impact on the public.

Regarding specific notification procedures, the Executive Yuan has sent a letter to relevant ministries, urging involved companies and institutions to strictly comply with Article 12 of the Personal Data Protection Act and Article 22 of its implementing regulations, and to promptly notify affected individuals through verbal, written, telephone, text, email, fax, electronic documents, or other diverse means, ensuring the public can immediately grasp the status of their rights and take early precautions.

To amplify the warning effect, the Executive Yuan also recommends that affected companies and institutions, in addition to individually notifying victims, post prominent notices on the front page of their official websites, mobile apps, or physical stores, clearly and specifically reminding the public of potential fraud tactics and risks. By publicly and transparently disclosing information, consumers can build anti-fraud awareness and reduce information gaps.

The Executive Yuan Fraud Prevention Command Center again reminds the public to stay extremely vigilant. Even if fraud groups can easily obtain your ID number, birth date, address, and other personal data, do not panic. Do not be led by their tactics; immediately hang up and call the 165 anti-fraud hotline for verification, while always checking the official website, app, or physical store notices of companies and institutions to ensure your personal assets remain safe.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉輝達財報優於預期 散熱三雄高掛三顆紅燈
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Nvidia Beats Forecast, Cooling Giants Trade High with Red Flags
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周二(17日)公告2027會計年度第三季財報，第三季營收1158.4億元，每股純益2.68元，營收與獲利皆優於預期，且給出強勁財測，身為供應鏈夥伴的散熱三雄健策(3653-TW)、奇鋐(3017-TW)及雙鴻(3324-TW)今(18)日走揚，並在午盤強勢上攻亮起紅燈。
輝達第三季營收1158.4億美元，每股純益2.68元，其中，資料中心營收達1976億美元，年增1.1倍。財測部分，預計第四季營收將達1300億美元。
健策第三季受惠Rubin系列產品出貨，帶動毛利率表現亮眼，法人預期，第四季Rubin均熱片出貨將持續升溫，加上AMD(AMD-US)新品放量，看好第四季營收持續成長。奇鋐前三季每股純益已達73.86元，賺逾7個股本，第四季持續受惠VR系列產品出貨帶動，法人同步看好營運。
雙鴻於VR系列原先聚焦的manifold(分歧管)及inner manifold(機櫃內部分歧管)產品，近期重回cold plate(水冷板)產品供應鏈。雙鴻將於今日召開法說會，屆時將釋出最新市況與展望。
健策早盤以4520元開高後，盤中翻黑，且一度跌逾半根停板，摔至4075元，不過盤中買盤湧進翻紅走高，午盤亮燈漲停鎖死4765元，排名千金股第4名，排隊委買單約500張，成交量超過4000張，且三大法人連續3個交易日買超，合計買超1326張。
奇鋐早盤以2540元開高，雖盤中一度翻黑，不過盤中再度翻紅走揚，午盤亮燈漲停鎖死2715元，排名千金股第13名，排隊委買單約500張，成交量超過5000張。
雙鴻同樣於午盤強拉，並衝上漲停板鎖死1015元，重回千金股行列，排隊委買單約100張，成交量超過4000張。另外，法人也連續3個交易日買超，合計買超1837張。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced on Tuesday (17th) its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results, reporting revenue of US$115.84 billion and earnings per share of NT$2.68, both exceeding expectations. The company also issued a strong outlook, prompting its supply‑chain partners—Cooling Giants Jianshe (3653‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW), and Shuanghong (3324‑TW)—to rally on the 18th, with all three hitting red‑flag highs in the afternoon session.

Nvidia’s third‑quarter revenue reached US$115.84 billion, with earnings per share of NT$2.68. Data‑center revenue hit US$197.6 billion, up 1.1× year‑over‑year. The company forecasts fourth‑quarter revenue of US$130 billion.

Jianshe benefited from shipments of the Rubin series, boosting its gross‑margin performance. Analysts expect Rubin’s all‑chip heat‑plate shipments to continue rising in Q4, and with AMD’s new products rolling out, they anticipate sustained revenue growth. Qihong’s EPS for the first three quarters reached NT$73.86, more than seven times its share capital; Q4 will again benefit from VR‑series product shipments, and analysts remain optimistic about operations.

Shuanghong, which had previously focused on manifold and inner‑manifold products for VR, has recently re‑entered the cold‑plate supply chain. The company will hold a earnings call today to release updated market conditions and outlook.

Jianshe opened the morning at NT$4,520, fell sharply mid‑day, briefly dropping over half a point to NT$4,075, but then recovered as buying pressure surged, closing the afternoon at a red‑flag limit of NT$4,765. It ranked fourth among “golden‑stock” listings, with about 500 limit‑order buy blocks and a trading volume exceeding 4,000 blocks. Three institutional investors bought in for three consecutive days, adding a total of 1,326 blocks.

Qihong opened the morning at NT$2,540, dipped mid‑day but rebounded, closing the afternoon at a red‑flag limit of NT$2,715. It ranked thirteenth among “golden‑stock” listings, with roughly 500 limit‑order buy blocks and a trading volume over 5,000 blocks.
