items.title: 黃仁勳「長期副手」捲中國晶片走私疑雲！曾掌管重要客戶包括黃樂、疑與美超微涉案高層有關
items.title_en: Jay Puri, Nvidia’s Long‑Term Associate, Faces Allegations of China Chip Smuggling and Possible Links to SMCI‑US Executive
paras: 輝達前銷售主管、前執行長黃仁勳的長期副手 Jay Puri 遭做空機構及媒體接連指控，疑與中國企業規避美國出口管制、將輝達人工智慧（AI）晶片運入中國的案件有關，也被質疑與美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 涉嫌違規銷售伺服器至中國的高階主管存在關係。
根據《The Information》周二（17日）報導，Puri過去曾是輝達大型客戶的重要聯繫窗口，其中包括前Megaspeed執行長黃樂（Alice Huang）。
據悉，黃樂曾與一家中國企業合作，秘密將至少75億美元的輝達AI晶片輸入中國。知情人士指出，該中國企業透過這項進口安排，規避美國出口管制限制。
根據報導，黃樂曾與輝達共同創辦人、前執行長黃仁勳有交往關係，而黃仁勳上周在董事會施壓下離職，黃樂則被懷疑是中國間諜。
美國當局先前已對Megaspeed展開調查，懷疑該公司協助將輝達晶片運送給中國企業，涉嫌違反出口管制規定。
此外，Puri也被指控稱與伺服器製造商美超微有私人關係，該公司多名高階主管今年3月遭刑事起訴，罪名涉及涉嫌將輝達晶片轉運至中國。
《The Information》的報導發布數小時前，做空機構泥水基金（Muddy Waters）才剛對普里與美超微前高階主管Cenly Chen之間的關聯提出質疑，並表示已放空輝達股票。部分美超微股東指控，Chen可能協助將伺服器非法銷往中國。
這些指控與美國一宗刑事案件有關。美超微包括共同創辦人在內的3名員工遭到起訴，被控向中國客戶銷售價值數十億美元、搭載輝達晶片的伺服器。
Puri長期擔任輝達銷售主管，直到今年稍早離開該職位，目前仍以顧問身分與輝達保持合作關係。
如今，輝達面臨更嚴格的監管審查，外界關注其晶片是否透過不同管道流入中國。美國跨黨派議員已要求黃仁勳赴參議院銀行委員會作證。
根據《Politico》先前報導，黃仁勳已同意出席，並將在眾議院接受閉門聽證。
本周，美國也收緊中國取得輝達晶片的規定，堵住先前允許中國大型AI開發商透過設於海外的資料中心，取得輝達先進晶片的管道。
輝達財務長兼臨時執行長克雷斯（Colette Kress）周二表示，公司將停止向中國銷售Hopper系列資料中心晶片。
paras_en: Former Nvidia sales executive and ex‑CEO Jay Puri, a long‑time associate of Nvidia’s former chief executive Jensen Huang, has been repeatedly targeted by short‑selling firms and media for alleged involvement in a scheme to help Chinese companies evade U.S. export controls and ship Nvidia AI chips into China, and has also been accused of having ties to senior executives at server maker Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) who are alleged to have violated sales regulations by shipping servers to China.
According to a report by The Information on Tuesday (17th), Puri had previously served as a key contact for several large Nvidia customers, including former Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang.

It is reported that Alice Huang worked with a Chinese company to secretly import at least $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips into China. Sources say the Chinese company used this import arrangement to circumvent U.S. export‑control restrictions.

The report states that Alice Huang had a relationship with Nvidia co‑founder and former CEO Jensen Huang, and that Jensen Huang resigned last week under board pressure, while Alice Huang is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
U.S. authorities have already launched an investigation into Megaspeed, suspecting the company of assisting in the shipment of Nvidia chips to Chinese firms in violation of export‑control rules.

In addition, Puri has been accused of having a personal relationship with server manufacturer Super Micro, whose several senior executives were criminally charged in March of this year for allegedly routing Nvidia chips to China.

A few hours before The Information’s story was released, short‑seller Muddy Waters had just raised questions about the connection between Puri and former Super Micro executive Cenly Chen, and announced that it had shorted Nvidia shares. Some Super Micro shareholders allege that Chen may have helped illegally ship servers to China.

These allegations are tied to a U.S. criminal case. Three employees at Super Micro, including a co‑founder, have been indicted for selling servers equipped with Nvidia chips to Chinese customers worth billions of dollars.
Puri had been Nvidia’s sales chief for many years until he left the position earlier this year, and he remains in a consulting role with the company.

Today, Nvidia is facing stricter regulatory scrutiny, and observers are concerned about whether its chips are flowing into China through alternative channels. Bipartisan U.S. lawmakers have called on Jensen Huang to testify before the Senate Banking Committee.
According to a prior Politico report, Jensen Huang has agreed to appear and will also testify in a closed‑door hearing in the House of Representatives.

This week, the United States tightened rules governing China’s access to Nvidia chips, closing a previously allowed channel that let large Chinese AI developers obtain advanced Nvidia chips through overseas data centers.
Nvidia CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress said on Tuesday that the company will stop selling Hopper‑series data‑center chips to China.

items.title: 美債殖利率攀升引爆華爾街論戰！高盛等機構看多 富達卻潑冷水：十年債殖利率飆到6%也不算便宜
items.title_en: Rising U.S. Treasury Yields Spark Wall Street Debate! Goldman Sachs and Others Bullish, Fidelity Dampens Hype: 10-Year Yield at 6% Still Not Cheap
paras: 美債市場持續承壓，殖利率不斷走高的同時，是否意味著買入機會已然浮現，正成為華爾街爭論的焦點。專家最新表示，即使美國10年債殖利率升至6%，也不足以斷言其估值已達極度便宜，此番謹慎觀點與高盛等看多機構形成鮮明對比。
富達國際全球宏觀及戰略資產配置主管Salman Ahmed表示，過去一週，受到美國通膨數據高於預期，以及Fed官員接連釋放偏鷹派信號影響，市場重新上調未來政策利率路徑，美債遭遇新一輪拋售。10年期殖利率一度升至5.12%左右，2年期達到4.86%。
雖然殖利率升高意味著新購債券可獲得更高利息回報，但富達認為，僅憑殖利率來到歷史較高水平，並不足以證明債券具有明顯投資價值。
Ahmed指出，富達的估值模型綜合考量殖利率曲線斜率、實質利率以及長期通膨水平等因素。在持續的通膨風險、不斷擴大的美國財政赤字，以及股債相關性發生變化的環境下，投資人需要重估長期美債的合理殖利率。即便10年債殖利率達到6%，在此框架下也不能稱其「極度便宜」。
目前，富達對美債各天期的久期配置總體保持中性，並強調美債對股市波動的對沖效果正在下降。在當前環境，股票和債券越來越可能同時下跌，這與美國財政赤字擴大、政府債務持續增加以及通膨更具持續性有關，因此即便債券票息收入較高，投資者仍可能因殖利率進一步上升而承受價格損失。
不同於富達的謹慎，高盛利率策略團隊預計，美國10年債殖利率可能從當前約5.1%的水平，在2027年底降至4.6%，判斷基礎在於未來通膨壓力逐漸緩和、Fed升息週期接近尾聲。
然而，T. Rowe Price等機構則對殖利率見頂持懷疑態度，警告若美國經濟未出現明顯衰退，美債殖利率恐難以形成持續性頂部。
近期市場表現凸顯上述矛盾。本月初，美國科技股因AI投資回報擔憂下跌時，美債一度受到避險資金追捧，但隨後通膨超預期，債市迅速轉跌，即便科技股繼續承壓，長期美債也未能持續發揮避險作用，顯示傳統的股債分散配置在通膨衝擊面前可能失效。
對長期債券投資者而言，能否獲得較高票息只是其一，更重要的是未來殖利率是否仍有大幅上行空間。
更值得關注的是美國官方干預風險。Ahmed指出，若美債殖利率快速逼近6%，美國政府恐被迫採取措施穩定市場，極端情況下甚至可能實施殖利率曲線控制(YCC)，也就是透過政策操作限制特定期限美債殖利率。
Ahmed預估此類極端情形的主觀機率約為25%至30%，而長債殖利率失控並迫使當局干預、進而強化貨幣貶值交易風險的概率約為20%至25%。
事實上，美國財長貝森特今年8月曾透過增加美債回購操作，試圖緩解長期融資成本上行壓力，但此舉一度引發市場對美元購買力與財政政策的擔憂。
所謂貨幣貶值交易，是指投資者擔心政府可能透過較寬鬆的金融條件減輕債務負擔，進而降低本幣及名義金融資產的實際購買力。
富達的謹慎立場並非要否定美債價值，而是強調傳統估值方法必須納入更高的通膨與財政風險溢價。
隨著美國債務規模膨脹與Fed政策預期反覆調整，市場需要判斷的不僅是美債殖利率能升多高，更在於這一殖利率是否足以補償未來可能發生的價格波動與政策風險。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market continues to be under pressure, and as yields rise, the question of whether buying opportunities have emerged has become a focal point of Wall Street debate. Experts now say that even if the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield climbs to 6%, it is not enough to conclude that its valuation is extremely cheap, a cautious view that sharply contrasts with the bullish stance of Goldman Sachs and others.

Fidelity International Global Macro and Strategic Asset Allocation head Salman Ahmed said that over the past week, higher-than‑expected U.S. inflation data and a string of hawkish signals from Fed officials pushed the market to raise its expectations for future policy rates, leading to a new round of Treasury selling. The 10‑year yield briefly rose to about 5.12%, while the 2‑year hit 4.86%.
Although higher yields mean new bonds can offer higher interest returns, Fidelity believes that simply reaching historically high levels is not enough to prove that bonds have clear investment value.

Ahmed pointed out that Fidelity’s valuation model takes into account the slope of the yield curve, real rates, and long‑term inflation levels. In an environment of persistent inflation risk, a widening U.S. fiscal deficit, and changing equity‑bond correlations, investors need to reassess the fair yield for long‑term Treasuries. Even if the 10‑year yield reaches 6%, it cannot be called "extremely cheap" under this framework.

Currently, Fidelity maintains a neutral stance on duration allocation across Treasury maturities and stresses that the hedging effect of Treasuries against stock market volatility is declining. In the current environment, stocks and bonds are increasingly likely to fall together, linked to a growing U.S. fiscal deficit, rising government debt, and more persistent inflation, so even with higher coupon income, investors may still suffer price losses as yields rise further.

Unlike Fidelity’s caution, Goldman Sachs’ rate strategy team expects the U.S. 10‑year yield to fall from its current level of about 5.1% to 4.6% by the end of 2027, based on easing inflation pressure and the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle nearing its end.

However, institutions such as T. Rowe Price remain skeptical about a peak in yields, warning that if the U.S. economy does not show clear signs of recession, Treasury yields may struggle to form a sustainable top.

Recent market performance highlighted this contradiction. Early this month, U.S. tech stocks fell amid concerns over AI investment returns, and Treasuries briefly benefited from safe‑haven flows, but after inflation surpassed expectations, the bond market quickly turned bearish. Even as tech stocks continued to be pressured, long‑term Treasuries failed to maintain a safe‑haven role, suggesting that traditional equity‑bond diversification may break down under inflationary shocks.
For long‑term bond investors, the ability to earn higher coupons is just one factor; the more important question is whether future yields still have significant upside potential.

A more concerning issue is the risk of U.S. official intervention. Ahmed noted that if Treasury yields rapidly approach 6%, the U.S. government may be forced to take measures to stabilize the market, and in extreme cases, could even implement yield‑curve control (YCC), i.e., policy actions that limit the yield on specific maturities.

Ahmed estimates the subjective probability of such an extreme scenario at about 25% to 30%, and the probability that long‑term yields spiral out of control, forcing intervention and thereby increasing the risk of currency‑devaluation trading, at about 20% to 25%.

In fact, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen in August this year increased Treasury repo operations to try to ease the upward pressure on long‑term financing costs, but this move temporarily raised concerns about dollar purchasing power and fiscal policy.

Currency‑devaluation trading refers to investors’ fears that the government may use looser financial conditions to ease debt burdens, thereby reducing the real purchasing power of the domestic currency and nominal financial assets.
Fidelity’s cautious stance does not deny the value of Treasuries; it simply emphasizes that traditional valuation methods must incorporate higher inflation and fiscal risk premiums.

As U.S. debt levels expand and Fed policy expectations shift repeatedly, the market must decide not only how high Treasury yields can rise, but also whether those yields are sufficient to compensate for potential future price volatility and policy risks.

items.title: 貝佐斯看衰外部空降輝達！直言「公司太複雜」：接班人應從內部找
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳因婚外情風波在上周離開掌舵了33年的公司，消息震撼科技業，目前輝達董事會正在尋找接棒人選，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)認為，由於輝達業務太過複雜，應該從內部尋找下一任執行長，若由外部人士接掌，成功機會微乎其微。
貝佐斯周二(17日)在美國線上媒體《Semafor》舉辦的「矽谷與世界」活動中說，「如果不讓Jensen回來，我就不會聘用外部人士。輝達太複雜了。」
貝佐斯補充，對於業務複雜的企業而言，外部執行長「成功的機會微乎其微」，聘用外部人士應該是「最後手段」。他目前擔任人工智慧(AI)工程新創公司Prometheus的共同執行長。
但輝達董事會主席Harvey Jones周二下午在輝達財報電話會議開場時明確表示，不會重新聘用黃仁勳，已著手尋找新任執行長。Jones說，接班人選搜尋範圍將涵蓋內部與外部候選人，董事會希望盡快找到正式執行長，但不會為了趕時間而倉促決定。
輝達目前由財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)擔任臨時執行長。
黃仁勳表態願回任 貝佐斯認為外部接班風險高
黃仁勳周二稍早已在社群平台X發布聲明，表示願意回任。他承認自己在個人生活方面「犯下嚴重錯誤」，並表示願意配合董事會的獨立調查。
黃仁勳寫道：「如果董事會認為，讓我回任符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最大利益，我將很榮幸接受這項邀請，回任執行長。」
黃仁勳上周四辭去輝達總裁、執行長和董事職務，他離任前一天才被《紐約時報》爆料與一名直屬下屬發生婚外情，幾天前另遭《華爾街日報》報導曾與被美國官員懷疑為中國間諜的黃樂(Alice Huang)發生婚外情，這些事件涉及公司治理和國安疑慮。
輝達兩大重要投資人、Altimeter Capital的Brad Gerstner及Atreides Management的Gavin Baker，已要求董事會保留「黃仁勳可能回任」的空間，此外，包括特斯拉(TSLA-US)和SpaceX(SPCX-US)馬斯克在內聲援黃仁勳復職的連署人數，已超過18萬人。
Yorkville Ives分析師Dan Ives則在周日發布的報告中表示，外界討論黃仁勳回鍋一事「荒謬」。
貝佐斯談亞馬遜交棒經驗 但表示不能拿來對照
貝佐斯也曾經歷創辦人交棒，他2021年把亞馬遜執行長職務交給長期任職公司、並打造AWS雲端業務的內部人士賈西(Andy Jassy)。
但當Semafor提出兩家公司交棒經驗的比較時，貝佐斯認為這並不是恰當的類比。他說亞馬遜當年的執行長交接，是他所見過規畫最周詳的交棒安排之一。
貝佐斯也說，他對輝達董事會會議的情況並沒有充分的了解，因此無法判斷黃仁勳是否應該回任。不過他認為黃仁勳是一位傑出的創辦人，無論發生什麼事，都值得「欽佩與尊重」。
黃仁勳本人則曾在《彭博》10月14日錄製的訪談中表示，他希望自己的接班人已經在公司內部任職。
這場訪談還談及其他議題。貝佐斯表示，藍源(Blue Origin)正在兩項專案中使用Prometheus的工具。他也說，美國總統川普是他接觸過的歷任總統中，溝通最頻繁的一位。
此外，貝佐斯認為，英國男星羅伯特·派汀森(Robert Pattinson)，是飾演第七代「007」詹姆斯龐德(James Bond)的明確人選。亞馬遜米高梅影業周一宣布，現年40歲、憑《暮光之城》、《奧德賽》等電影走紅全球的派汀森，打敗另外四名競爭者成為新任龐德。

items.title: 黃仁勳同意赴美參議院作證！輝達晶片疑流中國、Megaspeed案引發國會調查
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Testify Before U.S. Senate, Sparked Congressional Investigation Over Chip Flow to China and Megaspeed Case
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 前執行長黃仁勳同意赴美國參議院銀行委員會作證，接受國會議員公開聽證，說明輝達晶片疑似流向中國，以及他與一名涉嫌中國間諜人士的關係。相關爭議已引發外界對美國先進人工智慧（AI）晶片出口管制漏洞的關注。
根據《Politico》周二（17日）晚間報導，參議院銀行委員會主席史考特（Tim Scott）的發言人證實，黃仁勳已同意出席聽證會。不過，聽證會的具體日期與時間尚未公布。
史考特及多名跨黨派參議員先前曾要求黃仁勳與美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）出席公開聽證，針對輝達晶片疑似銷往中國，以及黃仁勳與一名涉嫌中國間諜人士的關係接受質詢。
這些相關爭議最終導致黃仁勳突然離開輝達執行長職位。
這將是黃仁勳首次在國會委員會公開作證。據報導，他先前也已同意在眾議院接受閉門聽證。盧特尼克則據悉同樣已同意赴參議院作證。
黃仁勳與盧特尼克目前面臨的審查日益升高，外界關注相關審查機制是否出現漏洞，導致輝達先進AI晶片流入中國。
這起風波源於黃仁勳與輝達員工及一名涉嫌中國間諜人士發生婚外情的消息曝光。其中，該名人士黃樂（Alice Huang）曾領導總部位於新加坡的Megaspeed。
美國商務部曾調查Megaspeed，指其涉嫌將晶片轉運給中國企業。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee, appearing at a public hearing to explain the alleged flow of NVIDIA chips to China and his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The controversy has raised concerns about loopholes in U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips.

According to a Politico report on Tuesday (the 17th) evening, a spokesperson for Senate Banking Committee Chair Tim Scott confirmed that Huang has agreed to attend the hearing, though the exact date and time have not yet been announced.

Scott and several bipartisan senators had previously requested that Huang and U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick appear at a public hearing to address the alleged sale of NVIDIA chips to China and to question Huang about his ties to a suspected Chinese spy.
These controversies ultimately led to Huang abruptly stepping down from his position as NVIDIA CEO.

This will be Huang’s first public testimony before a congressional committee. Reports say he has also agreed to a closed-door hearing in the House, and Lutnick is likewise said to have agreed to testify before the Senate.
Huang and Lutnick are currently facing increasing scrutiny, with observers concerned that the review mechanisms may have gaps that allowed NVIDIA’s advanced AI chips to reach China.
The scandal stemmed from revelations that Huang had an affair with a NVIDIA employee and a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang, who once led Singapore‑based Megaspeed.
The U.S. Department of Commerce has investigated Megaspeed, alleging that it was involved in shipping chips to Chinese companies.

items.title: 思科執行長：AI產業「不會因為一個人而停擺」
items.title_en: Cisco CEO: AI Industry Won’t Stall Because of One Person
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)創辦人黃仁勳，並沒有大到足以凌駕於他親手推動、帶領科技業進入AI熱潮的整個產業之上。這是來自一位重要客戶、也曾多次與黃仁勳同台談論科技議題人士所提出的提醒，他就是思科(Cisco)(CSCO-US)董事長兼執行長Chuck Robbins。
Robbins在節目「Sozzi Unleashed」中表示，「這個產業比任何一個人都重要。我不在乎你有多麼優秀，這個產業裡有很多非常聰明的人。輝達有42,000名員工，其他所有加速器公司也都有聰明的人才，超大規模雲端服務商也有許多人才正在開發這項技術。我們也有聰明的人才在打造AI和網路技術。整個科技產業匯集了各式各樣的頂尖智慧，因此，我對科技產業的未來並沒有那麼擔心。」
黃仁勳於1993年創立輝達，並將公司打造成AI革命中最重要的企業。如今，在一連串爆炸性消息曝光、爭議持續升高後，他離開執行長職位已滿一週。
根據《紐約時報》報導，黃仁勳據稱與一名被懷疑和中國情報機構有關聯的女性存在關係，使輝達受到前所未有的高度關注。
報導也指出，黃仁勳曾與輝達高層Kimberly Powell交往。Powell是直接向黃仁勳報告的約60名員工之一。《路透社》上週四則報導，黃仁勳還曾與另一名輝達員工有過關係，但該員工身分尚未公開。
黃仁勳與妻子Lori結婚超過40年，如今卻面臨令人震驚的聲譽逆轉。過去，他的領導形象建立在強悍的執行力，以及對輝達近乎傳奇般的掌控能力上。
輝達董事會現在正面臨一項艱鉅任務：尋找黃仁勳的接班人。目前公司已由長期擔任財務長的Colette Kress出任臨時執行長。
瑞銀分析師Tim Arcuri表示，「上週這場近期的管理層人事震盪發生後，我們聽到許多投資人對輝達長期產品藍圖感到擔憂。但我們認為這些疑慮被過度放大了，因為整個生態系統仍會持續推動產品藍圖向前發展。任何新任執行長幾乎都不會願意冒著失去競爭地位的風險，放棄每年推出新產品的節奏（儘管我們仍認為，採用更高密度設計的Kyber機櫃如今已不在考慮範圍內）。」
「至於新任執行長人選，我們認為公司很可能會從半導體及科技產業尋找人才，甚至可能嘗試從競爭對手挖角。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has not become so dominant as to surpass the entire industry he has personally driven into the AI boom. This reminder comes from an important client and frequent co‑speaker on tech topics, Cisco Chairman and CEO Chuck Robbins.

Robbins said on the "Sozzi Unleashed" show that "this industry is more important than any one person. I don’t care how brilliant you are; there are many smart people in this industry. Nvidia has 42,000 employees, other accelerator companies also have smart talent, and large‑scale cloud providers have many people developing this technology. We also have smart talent building AI and networking technology. The entire tech industry brings together a variety of top minds, so I’m not too worried about the future of the tech industry."

Jensen Huang founded Nvidia in 1993 and built the company into the most important player in the AI revolution. Today, after a series of explosive revelations and escalating controversies, he has been out of the CEO role for a full week.
According to the New York Times, Huang allegedly had a relationship with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, bringing unprecedented scrutiny to Nvidia.

The report also notes that Huang had a relationship with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell, one of about 60 employees who report directly to him. Reuters last Thursday reported that Huang had also been involved with another Nvidia employee, whose identity has not yet been disclosed.

Huang has been married to his wife Lori for over 40 years, but now faces a shocking reversal of reputation. In the past, his leadership image was built on fierce execution and near‑legendary control of Nvidia.
The Nvidia board now faces a daunting task: finding Huang’s successor. The company has appointed long‑time CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO.

Swiss‑based UBS analyst Tim Arcuri said, "After last week’s management shake‑up, we heard many investors worried about Nvidia’s long‑term product roadmap. We believe those concerns are overstated, because the entire ecosystem will continue to push the roadmap forward. Any new CEO would almost certainly not risk losing competitive position by abandoning the annual product cadence (although we still think the higher‑density Kyber cabinet is no longer in consideration)."
Regarding the new CEO, we believe the company is likely to look for talent in the semiconductor and tech industries, and may even try to poach from competitors."

items.title: 美國政府證實：去年夏天就約談黃仁勳小三黃樂！
items.title_en: U.S. Government Confirms: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Had an Affair with Megaspeed COO Alice Huang in Summer Last Year
paras: 輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 前執行長黃仁勳與新加坡雲端公司Megaspeed前執行長黃樂（Alice Huang）爆婚外情後，美國商務部與司法部表示，美方調查人員已於去年夏天親自約談黃樂。
據《CNN》17日（周二）報導，美國商務部與司法部在16日晚間發布的聯合聲明中納入了這個細節，並列出針對Megaspeed的調查時間軸。兩部門指出，商務部已於 2024 年因潛在出口管制違規行為對Megaspeed展開調查。
上述聲明發布前，美國商務部長盧特尼克連日來面臨嚴格審視，外界批評他對 Megaspeed的行動過於緩慢。財政部長貝森特也在13日進一步施壓，指責商務部延遲將這家輝達客戶列為潛在國安威脅。
商務部與司法部表示，商務部調查人員於 2025 年 5 月要求輝達提供「直接或間接銷售給 Megaspeed」的紀錄，而輝達隔月將 Megaspeed 打入「禁售」名單。
隨後商務部工業暨安全局人員與新加坡執法官員合作，於 2025 年 6 月在 Megaspeed 進行實地、面對面最終用途查核，並約談黃樂。
美國政府官員已確認黃樂與黃仁勳有過婚外情。美國情報圈一直在釐清黃樂與中國政府的關係，不過多名消息人士透露，迄今為止，針對她所蒐集到的情報，並不足以證明她曾為北京當局從事間諜活動。
Megaspeed 15日在聲明中表示，黃樂已於 2025 年 8 月離職，目前在該公司未擔任任何職務。Megaspeed同時反駁近期媒體針對該公司業務、供應鏈與全球營運的報導缺乏證據。
paras_en: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and former Megaspeed COO Alice Huang were reported to have had an affair, prompting U.S. Commerce and Justice Departments to personally interview Huang in the summer of last year.

CNN reported on Tuesday the 17th that a joint statement released by the Commerce and Justice Departments on the evening of the 16th included this detail and outlined the investigation timeline for Megaspeed. The departments noted that the Commerce Department began investigating Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export‑control violations.

Prior to the statement, Commerce Secretary Lutfy had faced intense scrutiny for his perceived slow response to Megaspeed, while Treasury Secretary Benson added pressure on the 13th, accusing Commerce of delaying the designation of the Nvidia customer as a potential national‑security threat.

The departments said that Commerce investigators requested Nvidia in May 2025 to provide records of “direct or indirect sales to Megaspeed,” and Nvidia added Megaspeed to its “prohibited‑sales” list the following month.

Subsequently, officials from the Bureau of Industry and Security worked with Singaporean law‑enforcement officers to conduct an on‑site, face‑to‑face end‑use inspection of Megaspeed in June 2025 and interview Alice Huang.

U.S. officials have confirmed that Huang and Jensen had an affair. U.S. intelligence has been clarifying Huang’s ties to the Chinese government, but several sources say that the intelligence gathered so far is insufficient to prove that she acted as a spy for Beijing.

Megaspeed stated in a statement on the 15th that Huang left the company in August 2025 and currently holds no position there. The company also rebutted recent media reports alleging a lack of evidence regarding its business, supply chain, and global operations.

items.title: 法人機構在輝達風波裡暗中調倉　普通投資人該怎樣布局應對？
items.title_en: Institutional Investors Quietly Rebalance Amid Nvidia Scandal, What Should Ordinary Investors Do?
paras: 輝達市值佔標普500指數總市值5.9%，數百萬美國人的401(k)退休帳戶與證券帳戶中皆有持股，而在創辦人黃仁勳突然離職引發公司治理疑慮後，普通投資人開始重新評估手中股票，有人逢低增持，有人考慮降低科技股集中度，也有人選擇續抱。在輝達週二(17日)公布創紀錄的第三財季業績前後，《華爾街日報》也報導分享了數名美國投資人的判斷與操作。
56歲的Philip Burrus是亞特蘭大的智慧財產權律師，習慣預留小部分資金投資市場關注度上升的公司。幾年前，他開始買入輝達，目前持倉佔整體投資組合不到1%。
Burrus說：「很長一段時間裡，輝達就像一枚火箭，股價一路飆升。最近幾週一直考慮增持，這讓我想起當年在蘋果、通用電氣股價低迷時買入的經歷。漢堡打折時，如果你平時就常吃，自然會想多買一些。」
黃仁勳離職風波一度打亂Burrus計畫，他讚賞董事會在黃仁勳被披露婚外情後迅速解雇，但當他得知部分人士推動黃仁勳復職、且黃仁勳週二表示願意回歸時，便暫時擱置增持計畫，甚至說黃仁勳若重掌公司可能出清。
輝達董事長Harvey Jones週二在財報會議上明確拒絕考慮讓黃仁勳復職，並已聘請獵頭尋找正式執行長。這讓Burrus改變主意，最終買入100股。「對我而言，這家公司在公司治理方面做出的決策才是最重要的。」
住在亞特蘭大的36歲保險核保總監Braden Quick說，自己定位為被動型投資者，幾年前便停止交易個股，將約80%資金投入先鋒領航全球股票ETF。但即便採取指數化策略，輝達仍佔其整體投資組合約4%。
最近，Quick開始重新審視資產配置，擔心對科技公司的依賴過高。「科技股怎麼走，標普500就怎麼走。」他的目標是未來25年內退休，同時承擔兩個孩子的大學費用，因此更希望組合提供穩定增長，而非過度依賴少數科技巨頭。
為控制集中度風險，Quick正考慮設定任何一家公司持股比例不得超過5%的規定。他說：「一家大型科技公司的執行長是否留任，不應成為決定個人投資者退休計畫或投資組合配置的因素。」
目前，Quick尚未實際調整，但正考慮將部分資金轉向對單一股票集中度設限的ETF，即管費用更高。他也對輝達強勁財報並不意外，但認為未來領導層安排仍存在不確定性。「問題在於，沒有黃仁勳掌舵，公司長期會有怎樣的表現？」
Quick甚至認為，若輝達經營不佳、持股佔比下降，反而可能緩解科技股集中度過高的問題，但他強調這絕非自己希望的結果。
在加州經營高管獵頭公司的71歲Rene Pharisien則與Burrus不同，認為董事會處理過於激烈，應考慮讓黃仁勳復職。「如果每家公司都因辦公室戀情解雇執行長，我懷疑符合任職資格的人選範圍會變得小得多。」
Pharisien從去年起逐步增加科技股配置，目前科技股已佔投資組合近40%，其中約四分之一配置於AI基礎設施，主要持有輝達、博通、美光和閃迪。他對輝達近期股價下跌並不意外，稱「這是很自然的市場反應」。
Pharisien對AI產業長期前景樂觀，並從自身工作觀察到企業對AI人才的需求。「現在每個人都想進入AI行業。如果我聯繫一名候選人，而職位和招聘宣傳中沒有涉及AI，他們就不會感興趣。」
Pharisien目前的投資組合約90%配置於股票，儘管輝達週二公布強勁業績、市場對未來增長抱有期待，他近期並不打算增持或賣出輝達股票。
這三位美國投資者面對同家公司的管理層風波和股價波動，輝達在標普權重達到5.9%，意味著這家公司的表現已跟大量普通投資者的財富和退休規劃緊密相連。黃仁勳離職帶來的影響，不再只是華爾街對一家科技巨頭的重新估值，而是直接關係到普通投資者如何看待科技股集中度、公司治理和長期投資風險。對於數百萬將退休金押注於美股指數的美國人而言，這場風波或許正是一個重新審視投資組合的契機。
paras_en: Nvidia’s market cap accounts for 5.9% of the S&P 500’s total market value, and millions of Americans hold the stock in their 401(k) and brokerage accounts. After founder Jensen Huang’s sudden resignation raised corporate‑governance concerns, ordinary investors began reassessing their holdings—some buying on dips, others reducing tech concentration, and some holding on. Shortly before and after Nvidia announced record‑breaking Q3 earnings on Tuesday (17th), the Wall Street Journal reported on several U.S. investors’ judgments and actions.

56‑year‑old Philip Burrus, an intellectual‑property lawyer in Atlanta, typically sets aside a small portion of his portfolio for high‑profile companies. A few years ago he began buying Nvidia, and it now represents less than 1% of his overall holdings.

Burrus said, "For a long time, Nvidia felt like a rocket, with the stock soaring. In recent weeks I’ve been considering adding more, which reminds me of buying Apple and GE when their prices were low. When a hamburger goes on sale, if you’re a regular, you’ll naturally want to buy more."

The Huang resignation turmoil disrupted Burrus’s plan. He praised the board for swiftly firing Huang after his extramarital affair was revealed, but when he learned that some pushed for Huang’s reinstatement and Huang announced on Tuesday that he was willing to return, Burrus temporarily shelved his buying plan and even said that if Huang took over again, he might liquidate the company.

On Tuesday, Nvidia chairman Harvey Jones explicitly rejected any consideration of Huang’s return and had already hired a headhunter to find a new CEO. This led Burrus to change his mind and ultimately purchase 100 shares. "For me, the decisions the company makes on governance are what matter most," he said.

A 36‑year‑old insurance underwriting director in Atlanta, Braden Quick, identifies as a passive investor. A few years ago he stopped trading individual stocks and allocated about 80% of his capital to the Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF. Even with an index strategy, Nvidia still accounts for roughly 4% of his portfolio.

Recently, Quick has begun re‑examining his asset allocation, worried about over‑reliance on tech companies. "The direction of tech stocks dictates the S&P 500’s direction," he said. His goal is to retire in 25 years and fund two children’s college tuition, so he prefers a portfolio that offers stable growth rather than heavy reliance on a few tech giants.

To control concentration risk, Quick is considering a rule that no single company’s holdings exceed 5%. He said, "Whether a large tech company’s CEO stays on should not dictate a personal investor’s retirement plan or portfolio allocation."

Quick has not yet made any adjustments but is considering shifting some capital into ETFs that limit single‑stock concentration, even if they have higher fees. He is not surprised by Nvidia’s strong earnings but believes future leadership arrangements remain uncertain. "The question is, without Huang at the helm, how will the company perform long term?"

Quick even thinks that if Nvidia’s performance falters and its ownership share declines, it could actually alleviate the problem of tech concentration, but he stresses that this is not the outcome he desires.

In California, 71‑year‑old executive recruiter Rene Pharisien differs from Burrus, believing the board acted too harshly and that Huang should be reinstated. "If every company fires a CEO over an office romance, I doubt the pool of qualified candidates would be large enough," he said.

Since last year, Pharisien has gradually increased his tech allocation, which now makes up nearly 40% of his portfolio, with about a quarter invested in AI infrastructure, mainly Nvidia, Broadcom, Micron and SanDisk. He was not surprised by Nvidia’s recent price drop, calling it a "natural market reaction."

Pharisien is optimistic about the long‑term prospects of AI and has observed the demand for AI talent in his work. "Everyone wants to enter the AI industry now. If I contact a candidate and the job posting doesn’t mention AI, they won’t be interested," he said.

Pharisien’s current portfolio is about 90% stocks. Despite Nvidia’s strong earnings announced on Tuesday and market expectations for future growth, he does not plan to buy more or sell Nvidia shares at the moment.

These three U.S. investors face the same company’s management turmoil and stock volatility. Nvidia’s weight in the S&P 500 reaches 5.9%, meaning the company’s performance is closely tied to the wealth and retirement plans of many ordinary investors. Huang’s resignation impacts not just Wall Street’s re‑valuation of a tech giant, but directly affects how everyday investors view tech concentration, corporate governance and long‑term investment risk. For millions of Americans who bet their pensions on the U.S. equity index, this scandal may be an opportunity to reassess their portfolios.

items.title: 富豪投資人看空銅價、美股空手觀望 朱肯米勒：現在目標是別賠錢
items.title_en: Wealthy Investor Bullish on Copper, Holds Cash in US Stocks, Says Goal Is Not to Lose Money
paras: 億萬富豪投資人朱肯米勒(Stan Druckenmiller)表示，由於前景的不確定性前所未見，他目前看空銅價，而且大多時間選擇在場外觀望，目的是不要賠錢。
朱肯米勒周二(17日)在奧斯汀舉行的TomorrowX Summit峰會上表示，他想不起來市場曾有哪個時期，對一年後的走勢如此缺乏明確方向。
這位Duquesne家族辦公室創辦人透露，自己目前僅持有少量美元部位，股票方面則既沒有做多，也沒有放空。他說：「我們基本上選擇避開市場。我們現在努力的方向是不要賠錢，而不是賺錢。」
至於何時重新進場，他回應說道：「我只是在休息。可能是兩天，也可能是六個月。我不知道。」
現年73歲的他也表示，他擔心美國移民政策正在威脅人才流入美國，然而一些頂尖企業都是由移民經營。

AI交易退潮 銅價自高點重挫逾一成

與許多投資人一樣，朱肯米勒今年初原本也持有銅的多頭部位。當時市場對人工智慧(AI)資料中心用銅需求抱持極高預期，與此同時，關稅相關的貿易扭曲也使實體市場供應趨緊。
就在兩個月前，倫敦金屬交易所(LME)銅價還一度觸及每噸約1.5萬美元的歷史新高。但隨著AI交易退潮，銅價這兩個月來已下跌逾一成。
Duquesne家族辦公室周一向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交最新13F持股申報文件，內容顯示9月30日該機構持有的美國上市股票和選擇權共44.7億美元，與6月底的52.1億美元相比明顯縮水，持股數也從95檔降至65檔。
13F文件也揭露了該機構第3季的持股變動，包括出清超微(AMD-US)、Sandisk(SNDK-US)和Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，不過也新建倉AppLovin(APP-US)、Palantir(PLTR-US)，並買進SpaceX(SPCX-US)。
根據彭博億萬富豪指數(Bloomberg Billionaires Index)，朱肯米勒身價估達125億美元。他以數十年的避險基金經理人生涯聞名，但後來關閉了旗下基金，把重心轉向家族辦公室。
paras_en: Stan Druckenmiller, a billionaire investor, said that due to unprecedented uncertainty in the outlook, he is bearish on copper prices and mostly stays on the sidelines to avoid losses.
On Tuesday (17th) at the TomorrowX Summit in Austin, Druckenmiller said he could not recall any period in the market where the direction for the next year was so unclear.

The founder of the Duquesne Family Office disclosed that he currently holds only a small amount of USD positions, and he has neither gone long nor short on equities. He said, "We basically choose to avoid the market. Our current focus is to avoid losses, not to make money."
When asked about when he might re-enter, he replied, "I'm just resting. It could be two days or six months. I don't know."
The 73‑year‑old also expressed concern that U.S. immigration policy is threatening the influx of talent, even though many top companies are run by immigrants.

Like many investors, Druckenmiller had a long position in copper at the beginning of the year. At that time, the market had high expectations for copper demand in AI data centers, and tariff‑related trade distortions tightened physical supply.

Just two months ago, the London Metal Exchange copper price briefly touched a historic high of about $15,000 per tonne. Since then, copper has fallen more than 10% over the past two months as AI trading cooled.

On Monday, the Duquesne Family Office filed its latest 13F with the SEC, showing that as of September 30, it held $4.47 billion in U.S. listed stocks and options, down from $5.21 billion at the end of June, and the number of holdings fell from 95 to 65.
The 13F also revealed the office’s Q3 changes, including liquidating AMD‑US, SNDK‑US, and GOOGL‑US, while opening new positions in APP‑US, PLTR‑US, and buying SPCX‑US.

According to Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index, Druckenmiller’s net worth is estimated at $12.5 billion. He is known for decades as a hedge‑fund manager, but later closed his fund and shifted focus to a family office.

items.title: 破天荒！傳蘋果與三星將達成長期DRAM供應協議　專家：記憶體供應鏈話語權逆轉
items.title_en: Unprecedented! Apple and Samsung Near Long-Term DRAM Supply Agreement, Experts Say Memory Supply Chain Power Reverses
paras: 記憶體晶片價格持續上漲，正悄然反轉供應商與客戶之間的強弱關係。外媒引述知情人士報導，蘋果與三星電子正接近達成一項DRAM長期供應協議(LTA)，期限四至五年，預計自明年上半年開始交付。這在習慣以短期合約壓價的蘋果採購史上是罕見破例。
知情人士透露，雙方將鎖定合約期內的DRAM最低供應量，但價格不會固定，而是依屆時市場行情調整。對蘋果而言，這是用價格彈性換供貨確定性；對三星而言，則可在較長週期內鎖住訂單與收入。
據悉，此前蘋果是主要科技巨頭中唯一與三星未簽訂DRAM長期供應協議的企業，此次轉向意義重大。
知情人士還指出，蘋果近期也與另一大記憶體供應商SK海力士簽署類似長約，條款同樣更偏向供應商。背後推力來自AI資料中心對HBM的爆發式需求。
三星、SK海力士與美光三大記憶體廠產能正向伺服器產品傾斜，手機與PC用的DRAM供給被壓縮，蘋果不得不放棄逐輪砍價策略。
隨著一連串LTA落地，「晶片通膨」持續的預期正在升溫。近期合約普遍以當前高價設定供應價格下限，意味著未來成本難有大幅回落空間。
分析師警告，若記憶體漲價持續傳導至手機、電腦終端，消費者可能延後換機，反過來在中長期拖累記憶體半導體需求。
目前，蘋果與三星均未對協議細節與金額作出回應。
paras_en: Memory chip prices continue to rise, quietly reversing the power balance between suppliers and customers. Foreign media, citing insiders, report that Apple and Samsung Electronics are close to reaching a long-term DRAM supply agreement (LTA) lasting four to five years, with deliveries expected to begin in the first half of next year. This is a rare break from Apple’s usual practice of using short-term contracts to drive prices down.

Insiders say the parties will lock in a minimum supply volume for the contract period, but the price will not be fixed; it will adjust according to market conditions at the time. For Apple, this trades price flexibility for supply certainty; for Samsung, it locks in orders and revenue over a longer horizon.
Previously, Apple was the only major tech giant that had not signed a long-term DRAM supply agreement with Samsung, making this shift highly significant.

Insiders also note that Apple recently signed a similar long-term deal with another major memory supplier, SK Hynix, with terms also favoring the supplier. The driving force behind this is the explosive demand for HBM from AI data centers.

Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron’s production capacity is increasingly skewed toward server products, compressing the supply of DRAM for phones and PCs, forcing Apple to abandon its round-by-round price-cutting strategy.

With a series of LTAs coming into force, the expectation of ongoing "chip inflation" is heating up. Recent contracts generally set the supply price floor at current high levels, meaning future costs are unlikely to see a significant drop.

Analysts warn that if memory price increases continue to filter into mobile phones and computers, consumers may postpone device upgrades, which in turn could drag down memory semiconductor demand in the medium to long term.
At present, neither Apple nor Samsung has responded to inquiries about the details or amounts of the agreement.

items.title: 黃仁勳「長期副手」捲中國晶片走私疑雲！曾掌管重要客戶包括黃樂、疑與美超微涉案高層有關
items.title_en: Jay Puri, Nvidia’s Long‑Term Associate, Faces Allegations of China Chip Smuggling and Possible Links to SMCI‑US Executive
paras: 輝達前銷售主管、前執行長黃仁勳的長期副手 Jay Puri 遭做空機構及媒體接連指控，疑與中國企業規避美國出口管制、將輝達人工智慧（AI）晶片運入中國的案件有關，也被質疑與美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 涉嫌違規銷售伺服器至中國的高階主管存在關係。
根據《The Information》周二（17日）報導，Puri過去曾是輝達大型客戶的重要聯繫窗口，其中包括前Megaspeed執行長黃樂（Alice Huang）。
據悉，黃樂曾與一家中國企業合作，秘密將至少75億美元的輝達AI晶片輸入中國。知情人士指出，該中國企業透過這項進口安排，規避美國出口管制限制。
根據報導，黃樂曾與輝達共同創辦人、前執行長黃仁勳有交往關係，而黃仁勳上周在董事會施壓下離職，黃樂則被懷疑是中國間諜。
美國當局先前已對Megaspeed展開調查，懷疑該公司協助將輝達晶片運送給中國企業，涉嫌違反出口管制規定。
此外，Puri也被指控稱與伺服器製造商美超微有私人關係，該公司多名高階主管今年3月遭刑事起訴，罪名涉及涉嫌將輝達晶片轉運至中國。
《The Information》的報導發布數小時前，做空機構泥水基金（Muddy Waters）才剛對普里與美超微前高階主管Cenly Chen之間的關聯提出質疑，並表示已放空輝達股票。部分美超微股東指控，Chen可能協助將伺服器非法銷往中國。
這些指控與美國一宗刑事案件有關。美超微包括共同創辦人在內的3名員工遭到起訴，被控向中國客戶銷售價值數十億美元、搭載輝達晶片的伺服器。
Puri長期擔任輝達銷售主管，直到今年稍早離開該職位，目前仍以顧問身分與輝達保持合作關係。
如今，輝達面臨更嚴格的監管審查，外界關注其晶片是否透過不同管道流入中國。美國跨黨派議員已要求黃仁勳赴參議院銀行委員會作證。
根據《Politico》先前報導，黃仁勳已同意出席，並將在眾議院接受閉門聽證。
本周，美國也收緊中國取得輝達晶片的規定，堵住先前允許中國大型AI開發商透過設於海外的資料中心，取得輝達先進晶片的管道。
輝達財務長兼臨時執行長克雷斯（Colette Kress）周二表示，公司將停止向中國銷售Hopper系列資料中心晶片。
paras_en: Former Nvidia sales executive and ex‑CEO Jay Puri, a long‑time associate of Nvidia’s former chief executive Jensen Huang, has been repeatedly targeted by short‑selling firms and media for alleged involvement in a scheme to help Chinese companies evade U.S. export controls and ship Nvidia AI chips into China, and has also been accused of having ties to senior executives at server maker Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) who are alleged to have violated sales regulations by shipping servers to China.
According to a report by The Information on Tuesday (17th), Puri had previously served as a key contact for several large Nvidia customers, including former Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang.

It is reported that Alice Huang worked with a Chinese company to secretly import at least $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips into China. Sources say the Chinese company used this import arrangement to circumvent U.S. export‑control restrictions.

The report states that Alice Huang had a relationship with Nvidia co‑founder and former CEO Jensen Huang, and that Jensen Huang resigned last week under board pressure, while Alice Huang is suspected of being a Chinese spy.
U.S. authorities have already launched an investigation into Megaspeed, suspecting the company of assisting in the shipment of Nvidia chips to Chinese firms in violation of export‑control rules.

In addition, Puri has been accused of having a personal relationship with server manufacturer Super Micro, whose several senior executives were criminally charged in March of this year for allegedly routing Nvidia chips to China.

A few hours before The Information’s story was released, short‑seller Muddy Waters had just raised questions about the connection between Puri and former Super Micro executive Cenly Chen, and announced that it had shorted Nvidia shares. Some Super Micro shareholders allege that Chen may have helped illegally ship servers to China.

These allegations are tied to a U.S. criminal case. Three employees at Super Micro, including a co‑founder, have been indicted for selling servers equipped with Nvidia chips to Chinese customers worth billions of dollars.
Puri had been Nvidia’s sales chief for many years until he left the position earlier this year, and he remains in a consulting role with the company.

Today, Nvidia is facing stricter regulatory scrutiny, and observers are concerned about whether its chips are flowing into China through alternative channels. Bipartisan U.S. lawmakers have called on Jensen Huang to testify before the Senate Banking Committee.
According to a prior Politico report, Jensen Huang has agreed to appear and will also testify in a closed‑door hearing in the House of Representatives.

This week, the United States tightened rules governing China’s access to Nvidia chips, closing a previously allowed channel that let large Chinese AI developers obtain advanced Nvidia chips through overseas data centers.
Nvidia CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress said on Tuesday that the company will stop selling Hopper‑series data‑center chips to China.

items.title: 普丁出席APEC峰會發表演說 狠批歐盟並推進「去美元化」
items.title_en: Putin Attends APEC Summit, Delivers Speech, Harshly Criticizes EU and Advances ‘De‑Dollarisation’
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁周三(18日)飛抵中國深圳，出席亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)經濟領袖會議及其企業領袖峰會。他在開幕演說中強調，西方隔離俄羅斯的企圖已經失敗，俄國經濟展現出強大韌性，並公開宣示俄羅斯貿易中的「去美元化」取得顯著進展。
普丁在 APEC 企業領袖峰會發表演說時指出，儘管面臨多重國際制裁，俄羅斯仍尊嚴地克服各項挑戰，並正全力推進與亞太地區的互利合作。
他強調，全球經濟分化與地緣政治風險加劇之際，各國更需深化合作。俄方正積極擴展東部地區的物流與運輸能力，以強化與 APEC 成員國的經貿紐帶，並稱俄羅斯在數位轉型領域已具備領先地位。
在貿易結算與能源議題上，普丁明確表示，俄羅斯貿易結算中美元的所佔比例已急劇下降。同時，他對歐盟發動強烈批判，指出歐盟因失去俄羅斯廉價能源，正在喪失工業產能與市場競爭力，面臨高額債務及生活水準下降的窘境。
此外，普丁還向 APEC 成員國喊話，爭取支持俄羅斯於 2035 年再次主辦 APEC 峰會。
普丁在抵達當日即與中國國家主席習近平舉行會談，這是兩人於 2026 年內的第五次會晤。根據俄方數據，2026 年前 10 個月中國與俄羅斯的雙邊貿易額已達 2,425 億美元，年增近 33%，超越 2025 年全年總額，其中能源、石化與核能合作為重要支柱。
此行另一焦點為預計於 19 日登場的美中俄三方領袖峰會。美國總統川普在結束東南亞行程後轉赴深圳，白宮指出川普將在會中提出核裁軍議題；俄方外事顧問烏沙科夫則表示，會談將持續探討烏克蘭衝突的談判解決方案。
儘管俄方高調展示經濟活力，但外界分析指出，受高利率、通膨壓力及煉油產能下降等因素影響，俄國第三季 GDP 年增率已放緩至 1%。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen, China on Wednesday (the 18th) to attend the Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting and its Business Leaders’ Summit. In his opening remarks he stressed that the West’s attempt to isolate Russia has failed, the Russian economy has shown strong resilience, and he publicly declared that de‑dollarisation in Russian trade has made significant progress.

During his speech at the APEC Business Leaders’ Summit, Putin noted that despite facing multiple international sanctions, Russia has dignifiedly overcome various challenges and is fully pushing forward mutually beneficial cooperation with the Asia‑Pacific region.

He emphasized that as global economic fragmentation and geopolitical risks intensify, countries need deeper cooperation. Russia is actively expanding logistics and transport capacity in its eastern regions to strengthen trade ties with APEC members, and he claimed that Russia now holds a leading position in digital transformation.

On trade settlement and energy issues, Putin stated unequivocally that the share of the US dollar in Russian trade settlements has dropped sharply. He also launched a strong critique of the EU, pointing out that having lost cheap Russian energy, the EU is losing industrial capacity and market competitiveness, and is facing high debt and a decline in living standards.
Furthermore, Putin called on APEC member states to support Russia’s bid to host the APEC summit again in 2035.

On the day of his arrival, Putin held talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, marking their fifth meeting in 2026. According to Russian data, bilateral trade between China and Russia in the first ten months of 2026 reached $242.5 billion, up nearly 33% year‑on‑year and surpassing the total for all of 2025, with energy, petrochemicals and nuclear cooperation as key pillars.

Another focus of the trip was the trilateral leaders’ summit of the United States, China and Russia scheduled for the 19th. After concluding his Southeast Asia tour, U.S. President Donald Trump flew to Shenzhen; the White House said Trump will raise nuclear disarmament at the meeting, while Russian foreign policy adviser Ushakov said talks will continue to explore a negotiated settlement to the Ukraine conflict.

Although Russia is publicly showcasing economic vitality, external analysts note that high interest rates, inflation pressures and a decline in refining capacity have slowed Russia’s Q3 GDP annual growth rate to 1%.

items.title: 美債殖利率攀升引爆華爾街論戰！高盛等機構看多 富達卻潑冷水：十年債殖利率飆到6%也不算便宜
items.title_en: Rising U.S. Treasury Yields Spark Wall Street Debate! Goldman Sachs and Others Bullish, Fidelity Dampens Hype: 10-Year Yield at 6% Still Not Cheap
paras: 美債市場持續承壓，殖利率不斷走高的同時，是否意味著買入機會已然浮現，正成為華爾街爭論的焦點。專家最新表示，即使美國10年債殖利率升至6%，也不足以斷言其估值已達極度便宜，此番謹慎觀點與高盛等看多機構形成鮮明對比。
富達國際全球宏觀及戰略資產配置主管Salman Ahmed表示，過去一週，受到美國通膨數據高於預期，以及Fed官員接連釋放偏鷹派信號影響，市場重新上調未來政策利率路徑，美債遭遇新一輪拋售。10年期殖利率一度升至5.12%左右，2年期達到4.86%。
雖然殖利率升高意味著新購債券可獲得更高利息回報，但富達認為，僅憑殖利率來到歷史較高水平，並不足以證明債券具有明顯投資價值。
Ahmed指出，富達的估值模型綜合考量殖利率曲線斜率、實質利率以及長期通膨水平等因素。在持續的通膨風險、不斷擴大的美國財政赤字，以及股債相關性發生變化的環境下，投資人需要重估長期美債的合理殖利率。即便10年債殖利率達到6%，在此框架下也不能稱其「極度便宜」。
目前，富達對美債各天期的久期配置總體保持中性，並強調美債對股市波動的對沖效果正在下降。在當前環境，股票和債券越來越可能同時下跌，這與美國財政赤字擴大、政府債務持續增加以及通膨更具持續性有關，因此即便債券票息收入較高，投資者仍可能因殖利率進一步上升而承受價格損失。
不同於富達的謹慎，高盛利率策略團隊預計，美國10年債殖利率可能從當前約5.1%的水平，在2027年底降至4.6%，判斷基礎在於未來通膨壓力逐漸緩和、Fed升息週期接近尾聲。
然而，T. Rowe Price等機構則對殖利率見頂持懷疑態度，警告若美國經濟未出現明顯衰退，美債殖利率恐難以形成持續性頂部。
近期市場表現凸顯上述矛盾。本月初，美國科技股因AI投資回報擔憂下跌時，美債一度受到避險資金追捧，但隨後通膨超預期，債市迅速轉跌，即便科技股繼續承壓，長期美債也未能持續發揮避險作用，顯示傳統的股債分散配置在通膨衝擊面前可能失效。
對長期債券投資者而言，能否獲得較高票息只是其一，更重要的是未來殖利率是否仍有大幅上行空間。
更值得關注的是美國官方干預風險。Ahmed指出，若美債殖利率快速逼近6%，美國政府恐被迫採取措施穩定市場，極端情況下甚至可能實施殖利率曲線控制(YCC)，也就是透過政策操作限制特定期限美債殖利率。
Ahmed預估此類極端情形的主觀機率約為25%至30%，而長債殖利率失控並迫使當局干預、進而強化貨幣貶值交易風險的概率約為20%至25%。
事實上，美國財長貝森特今年8月曾透過增加美債回購操作，試圖緩解長期融資成本上行壓力，但此舉一度引發市場對美元購買力與財政政策的擔憂。
所謂貨幣貶值交易，是指投資者擔心政府可能透過較寬鬆的金融條件減輕債務負擔，進而降低本幣及名義金融資產的實際購買力。
富達的謹慎立場並非要否定美債價值，而是強調傳統估值方法必須納入更高的通膨與財政風險溢價。
隨著美國債務規模膨脹與Fed政策預期反覆調整，市場需要判斷的不僅是美債殖利率能升多高，更在於這一殖利率是否足以補償未來可能發生的價格波動與政策風險。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market continues to be under pressure, and as yields rise, the question of whether buying opportunities have emerged has become a focal point of Wall Street debate. Experts now say that even if the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield climbs to 6%, it is not enough to conclude that its valuation is extremely cheap, a cautious view that sharply contrasts with the bullish stance of Goldman Sachs and others.

Fidelity International Global Macro and Strategic Asset Allocation head Salman Ahmed said that over the past week, higher-than‑expected U.S. inflation data and a string of hawkish signals from Fed officials pushed the market to raise its expectations for future policy rates, leading to a new round of Treasury selling. The 10‑year yield briefly rose to about 5.12%, while the 2‑year hit 4.86%.
Although higher yields mean new bonds can offer higher interest returns, Fidelity believes that simply reaching historically high levels is not enough to prove that bonds have clear investment value.

Ahmed pointed out that Fidelity’s valuation model takes into account the slope of the yield curve, real rates, and long‑term inflation levels. In an environment of persistent inflation risk, a widening U.S. fiscal deficit, and changing equity‑bond correlations, investors need to reassess the fair yield for long‑term Treasuries. Even if the 10‑year yield reaches 6%, it cannot be called "extremely cheap" under this framework.

Currently, Fidelity maintains a neutral stance on duration allocation across Treasury maturities and stresses that the hedging effect of Treasuries against stock market volatility is declining. In the current environment, stocks and bonds are increasingly likely to fall together, linked to a growing U.S. fiscal deficit, rising government debt, and more persistent inflation, so even with higher coupon income, investors may still suffer price losses as yields rise further.

Unlike Fidelity’s caution, Goldman Sachs’ rate strategy team expects the U.S. 10‑year yield to fall from its current level of about 5.1% to 4.6% by the end of 2027, based on easing inflation pressure and the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle nearing its end.

However, institutions such as T. Rowe Price remain skeptical about a peak in yields, warning that if the U.S. economy does not show clear signs of recession, Treasury yields may struggle to form a sustainable top.

Recent market performance highlighted this contradiction. Early this month, U.S. tech stocks fell amid concerns over AI investment returns, and Treasuries briefly benefited from safe‑haven flows, but after inflation surpassed expectations, the bond market quickly turned bearish. Even as tech stocks continued to be pressured, long‑term Treasuries failed to maintain a safe‑haven role, suggesting that traditional equity‑bond diversification may break down under inflationary shocks.
For long‑term bond investors, the ability to earn higher coupons is just one factor; the more important question is whether future yields still have significant upside potential.

A more concerning issue is the risk of U.S. official intervention. Ahmed noted that if Treasury yields rapidly approach 6%, the U.S. government may be forced to take measures to stabilize the market, and in extreme cases, could even implement yield‑curve control (YCC), i.e., policy actions that limit the yield on specific maturities.

Ahmed estimates the subjective probability of such an extreme scenario at about 25% to 30%, and the probability that long‑term yields spiral out of control, forcing intervention and thereby increasing the risk of currency‑devaluation trading, at about 20% to 25%.

In fact, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen in August this year increased Treasury repo operations to try to ease the upward pressure on long‑term financing costs, but this move temporarily raised concerns about dollar purchasing power and fiscal policy.

Currency‑devaluation trading refers to investors’ fears that the government may use looser financial conditions to ease debt burdens, thereby reducing the real purchasing power of the domestic currency and nominal financial assets.
Fidelity’s cautious stance does not deny the value of Treasuries; it simply emphasizes that traditional valuation methods must incorporate higher inflation and fiscal risk premiums.

As U.S. debt levels expand and Fed policy expectations shift repeatedly, the market must decide not only how high Treasury yields can rise, but also whether those yields are sufficient to compensate for potential future price volatility and policy risks.

items.title: 貝佐斯看衰外部空降輝達！直言「公司太複雜」：接班人應從內部找
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳因婚外情風波在上周離開掌舵了33年的公司，消息震撼科技業，目前輝達董事會正在尋找接棒人選，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)認為，由於輝達業務太過複雜，應該從內部尋找下一任執行長，若由外部人士接掌，成功機會微乎其微。
貝佐斯周二(17日)在美國線上媒體《Semafor》舉辦的「矽谷與世界」活動中說，「如果不讓Jensen回來，我就不會聘用外部人士。輝達太複雜了。」
貝佐斯補充，對於業務複雜的企業而言，外部執行長「成功的機會微乎其微」，聘用外部人士應該是「最後手段」。他目前擔任人工智慧(AI)工程新創公司Prometheus的共同執行長。
但輝達董事會主席Harvey Jones周二下午在輝達財報電話會議開場時明確表示，不會重新聘用黃仁勳，已著手尋找新任執行長。Jones說，接班人選搜尋範圍將涵蓋內部與外部候選人，董事會希望盡快找到正式執行長，但不會為了趕時間而倉促決定。
輝達目前由財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)擔任臨時執行長。
黃仁勳表態願回任 貝佐斯認為外部接班風險高
黃仁勳周二稍早已在社群平台X發布聲明，表示願意回任。他承認自己在個人生活方面「犯下嚴重錯誤」，並表示願意配合董事會的獨立調查。
黃仁勳寫道：「如果董事會認為，讓我回任符合股東、員工、公司及美國的最大利益，我將很榮幸接受這項邀請，回任執行長。」
黃仁勳上周四辭去輝達總裁、執行長和董事職務，他離任前一天才被《紐約時報》爆料與一名直屬下屬發生婚外情，幾天前另遭《華爾街日報》報導曾與被美國官員懷疑為中國間諜的黃樂(Alice Huang)發生婚外情，這些事件涉及公司治理和國安疑慮。
輝達兩大重要投資人、Altimeter Capital的Brad Gerstner及Atreides Management的Gavin Baker，已要求董事會保留「黃仁勳可能回任」的空間，此外，包括特斯拉(TSLA-US)和SpaceX(SPCX-US)馬斯克在內聲援黃仁勳復職的連署人數，已超過18萬人。
Yorkville Ives分析師Dan Ives則在周日發布的報告中表示，外界討論黃仁勳回鍋一事「荒謬」。
貝佐斯談亞馬遜交棒經驗 但表示不能拿來對照
貝佐斯也曾經歷創辦人交棒，他2021年把亞馬遜執行長職務交給長期任職公司、並打造AWS雲端業務的內部人士賈西(Andy Jassy)。
但當Semafor提出兩家公司交棒經驗的比較時，貝佐斯認為這並不是恰當的類比。他說亞馬遜當年的執行長交接，是他所見過規畫最周詳的交棒安排之一。
貝佐斯也說，他對輝達董事會會議的情況並沒有充分的了解，因此無法判斷黃仁勳是否應該回任。不過他認為黃仁勳是一位傑出的創辦人，無論發生什麼事，都值得「欽佩與尊重」。
黃仁勳本人則曾在《彭博》10月14日錄製的訪談中表示，他希望自己的接班人已經在公司內部任職。
這場訪談還談及其他議題。貝佐斯表示，藍源(Blue Origin)正在兩項專案中使用Prometheus的工具。他也說，美國總統川普是他接觸過的歷任總統中，溝通最頻繁的一位。
此外，貝佐斯認為，英國男星羅伯特·派汀森(Robert Pattinson)，是飾演第七代「007」詹姆斯龐德(James Bond)的明確人選。亞馬遜米高梅影業周一宣布，現年40歲、憑《暮光之城》、《奧德賽》等電影走紅全球的派汀森，打敗另外四名競爭者成為新任龐德。

items.title: 日歐車用Chiplet標準出爐，矽中介層PDK預計2027年初釋出，自駕晶片邁向多供應商整合
items.title_en: Japan and Europe Set Automotive Chiplet Standard, Silicon Interposer PDK Expected Early 2027, Self‑Driving Chips Move Toward Multi‑Supplier Integration
paras: 2026年11月18日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 車用AI晶片的遊戲規則正在改寫。比利時微電子研究中心imec與日本車用SoC研究組織ASRA，11月12日在日本Autonomous Edge Chiplet Forum共同發布第一版車用Chiplet互通架構規範ACIR，日本與歐洲首度在自駕晶片的互通標準上走到同一套框架。
這套規範從宣布合作到正式發布不到一年。imec與ASRA在2025年12月宣布策略合作，當時imec的車用Chiplet計畫已串連20家國際夥伴，ASRA則集結日本主要車廠與供應商。原定2026年中發布聯合規格，實際晚了約一季，但標準成形的速度仍遠快於車用產業一般的認證節奏。
ACIR的關鍵在於「只規定能力，不規定做法」。規範涵蓋錯誤與系統管理、開機程序、電源管理、功能安全及車用互通性，只要求可互通的Chiplet必須支援哪些功能，不限制各家如何實作。這代表未來車廠可以把不同供應商的運算、AI加速與I/O晶粒組成一顆自駕晶片，不必綁在單一平台上。
需求來源是車載運算量的快速上升。軟體定義汽車、ADAS與自動駕駛需要高度整合的半導體，單晶片設計愈來愈難兼顧效能、成本與良率，Chiplet因此成為業界解方。imec也順勢把原本的Automotive Chiplet Program擴大為自主邊緣晶片計畫AECP，應用範圍從汽車延伸到機器人與航太，驗證重點涵蓋效能、功能安全、可靠性與長期供貨。

日本客製晶片設計商Socionext(6526-JP)早在標準出爐前三個月便提前布局，今年8月加入AECP。此前，公司已於2025年取得aiMotive的aiWare NPU授權、續約imec先進封裝研究合作，並推出可整合不同供應商IP的Flexlets Chiplet設計庫；今年9月再攜手Arteris(AIP-US)開發UCIe多晶粒方案。從AI運算IP、Chiplet設計、晶粒互連到標準制定，逐步建立完整的車用Chiplet技術布局。
真正值得市場注意的，不只是Socionext個別布局，而是開放生態對產業的重新分工。標準一旦統一，客戶可以混搭不同IP，像Socionext這類IP設計服務商的角色隨之放大，垂直整合的封閉平台則可能面臨議價壓力。不過輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)在日本的生態系已涵蓋豐田、發那科、安川電機、川崎重工、富士通、日立、NEC與索尼，兩條路線短期內較可能並存。
參與者也正從日歐向外擴散。新加坡封裝業者Silicon Box與印度拉森托博Larsen & Toubro(LT-IN)旗下的L&T Semiconductor Technologies，今年4月都已加入同一計畫，陣營橫跨日本、歐洲、東南亞與印度。
日本的邊緣AI供應鏈同步逐層補齊。索尼半導體解決方案與台積電(2330-TW)規劃在熊本合資設廠，生產車用與機器人的新一代影像感測器；imec也在11月於北海道設立研發據點。研究機構Mordor Intelligence估計，日本邊緣AI市場將從2025年的2.81億美元，成長至2031年的8.81億美元，年複合成長率21.04%。
商業化的時程仍需逐一驗證。ACIR第一版目前仍在徵求業界意見，下一個節點是imec預計2027年初釋出矽中介層PDK，這是實作Chiplet的基礎工具。中期真正的考驗在於Socionext的Chiplet SoC能否打進車廠量產設計，參與研究計畫不等於設計導入；車用認證週期長，從標準到量產可能需要數年。

paras_en: On November 18, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – the rules of the road for automotive AI chips are being rewritten. The Belgian microelectronics research center imec and Japan’s automotive SoC research organization ASRA jointly released the first version of the automotive Chiplet Interoperability Architecture (ACIR) at the Autonomous Edge Chiplet Forum in Japan on November 12, marking the first time Japan and Europe have aligned on a single framework for self‑driving chip interoperability.

The standard was announced and released in less than a year. imec and ASRA announced a strategic partnership in December 2025; at that time imec’s automotive Chiplet program had already linked 20 international partners, while ASRA had gathered major Japanese automakers and suppliers. The joint specification was originally slated for mid‑2026 but was delayed by about a quarter; nevertheless, the pace at which the standard took shape was still far faster than the typical certification rhythm in the automotive industry.

The key to ACIR is that it "specifies capabilities, not implementation." The specification covers error and system management, boot procedures, power management, functional safety, and automotive interoperability, requiring only that interoperable Chiplets support certain functions without dictating how each vendor implements them. This means that in the future automakers can assemble a self‑driving chip from computing, AI acceleration, and I/O grains from different suppliers without being tied to a single platform.

The demand comes from the rapid rise in in‑vehicle computing power. Software‑defined cars, ADAS, and autonomous driving require highly integrated semiconductors, and single‑chip designs are increasingly difficult to balance performance, cost, and yield. Chiplets therefore become the industry’s solution. imec has also expanded its original Automotive Chiplet Program into the Autonomous Edge Chiplet Program (AECP), extending its scope from automotive to robotics and aerospace, with a focus on performance, functional safety, reliability, and long‑term supply.

Japanese custom chip designer Socionext (6526‑JP) had already begun positioning itself three months before the standard was released, joining AECP in August. Earlier, the company had secured aiMotive’s aiWare NPU license in 2025, renewed its advanced packaging research collaboration with imec, and launched the Flexlets Chiplet design library that integrates IP from different suppliers. In September, it partnered with Arteris (AIP‑US) to develop a UCIe multi‑chiplet solution. From AI compute IP, Chiplet design, grain interconnect to standard development, it has gradually built a complete automotive Chiplet technology portfolio.

What truly matters to the market is not just Socionext’s individual positioning but the open ecosystem’s reshaping of industry division of labor. Once the standard is unified, customers can mix and match different IPs, amplifying the role of IP design service providers like Socionext, while vertically integrated closed platforms may face pricing pressure. However, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) already has an ecosystem in Japan that includes Toyota, Fanuc, Yaskawa, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Fujitsu, Hitachi, NEC, and Sony, so both approaches are likely to coexist in the short term.

Participants are also expanding beyond Japan and Europe. Singapore’s packaging company Silicon Box and India’s Larsen & Toubro (L&T) Semiconductor Technologies joined the same program in April, creating a coalition that spans Japan, Europe, Southeast Asia, and India.

Japan’s edge‑AI supply chain is simultaneously filling out layer by layer. Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC (2330‑TW) plan a joint venture in Kumamoto to produce next‑generation image sensors for automotive and robotics; imec also opened an R&D site in Hokkaido in November. Mordor Intelligence estimates that Japan’s edge‑AI market will grow from $281 million in 2025 to $881 million by 2031, a compound annual growth rate of 21.04%.

Commercialization timelines still need to be validated one by one. The first version of ACIR is still gathering industry feedback; the next milestone is imec’s planned release of a silicon interposer PDK in early 2027, which is the foundational tool for implementing Chiplets. The real mid‑term test will be whether Socionext’s Chiplet SoC can penetrate automotive production designs; participation in research projects does not equal design adoption. Automotive certification cycles are long, and moving from standard to production may take several years.

items.title: 黃仁勳同意赴美參議院作證！輝達晶片疑流中國、Megaspeed案引發國會調查
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Testify Before U.S. Senate, Sparked Congressional Investigation Over Chip Flow to China and Megaspeed Case
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 前執行長黃仁勳同意赴美國參議院銀行委員會作證，接受國會議員公開聽證，說明輝達晶片疑似流向中國，以及他與一名涉嫌中國間諜人士的關係。相關爭議已引發外界對美國先進人工智慧（AI）晶片出口管制漏洞的關注。
根據《Politico》周二（17日）晚間報導，參議院銀行委員會主席史考特（Tim Scott）的發言人證實，黃仁勳已同意出席聽證會。不過，聽證會的具體日期與時間尚未公布。
史考特及多名跨黨派參議員先前曾要求黃仁勳與美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）出席公開聽證，針對輝達晶片疑似銷往中國，以及黃仁勳與一名涉嫌中國間諜人士的關係接受質詢。
這些相關爭議最終導致黃仁勳突然離開輝達執行長職位。
這將是黃仁勳首次在國會委員會公開作證。據報導，他先前也已同意在眾議院接受閉門聽證。盧特尼克則據悉同樣已同意赴參議院作證。
黃仁勳與盧特尼克目前面臨的審查日益升高，外界關注相關審查機制是否出現漏洞，導致輝達先進AI晶片流入中國。
這起風波源於黃仁勳與輝達員工及一名涉嫌中國間諜人士發生婚外情的消息曝光。其中，該名人士黃樂（Alice Huang）曾領導總部位於新加坡的Megaspeed。
美國商務部曾調查Megaspeed，指其涉嫌將晶片轉運給中國企業。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee, appearing at a public hearing to explain the alleged flow of NVIDIA chips to China and his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The controversy has raised concerns about loopholes in U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips.

According to a Politico report on Tuesday (the 17th) evening, a spokesperson for Senate Banking Committee Chair Tim Scott confirmed that Huang has agreed to attend the hearing, though the exact date and time have not yet been announced.

Scott and several bipartisan senators had previously requested that Huang and U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick appear at a public hearing to address the alleged sale of NVIDIA chips to China and to question Huang about his ties to a suspected Chinese spy.
These controversies ultimately led to Huang abruptly stepping down from his position as NVIDIA CEO.

This will be Huang’s first public testimony before a congressional committee. Reports say he has also agreed to a closed-door hearing in the House, and Lutnick is likewise said to have agreed to testify before the Senate.
Huang and Lutnick are currently facing increasing scrutiny, with observers concerned that the review mechanisms may have gaps that allowed NVIDIA’s advanced AI chips to reach China.
The scandal stemmed from revelations that Huang had an affair with a NVIDIA employee and a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang, who once led Singapore‑based Megaspeed.
The U.S. Department of Commerce has investigated Megaspeed, alleging that it was involved in shipping chips to Chinese companies.

items.title: 思科執行長：AI產業「不會因為一個人而停擺」
items.title_en: Cisco CEO: AI Industry Won’t Stall Because of One Person
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)創辦人黃仁勳，並沒有大到足以凌駕於他親手推動、帶領科技業進入AI熱潮的整個產業之上。這是來自一位重要客戶、也曾多次與黃仁勳同台談論科技議題人士所提出的提醒，他就是思科(Cisco)(CSCO-US)董事長兼執行長Chuck Robbins。
Robbins在節目「Sozzi Unleashed」中表示，「這個產業比任何一個人都重要。我不在乎你有多麼優秀，這個產業裡有很多非常聰明的人。輝達有42,000名員工，其他所有加速器公司也都有聰明的人才，超大規模雲端服務商也有許多人才正在開發這項技術。我們也有聰明的人才在打造AI和網路技術。整個科技產業匯集了各式各樣的頂尖智慧，因此，我對科技產業的未來並沒有那麼擔心。」
黃仁勳於1993年創立輝達，並將公司打造成AI革命中最重要的企業。如今，在一連串爆炸性消息曝光、爭議持續升高後，他離開執行長職位已滿一週。
根據《紐約時報》報導，黃仁勳據稱與一名被懷疑和中國情報機構有關聯的女性存在關係，使輝達受到前所未有的高度關注。
報導也指出，黃仁勳曾與輝達高層Kimberly Powell交往。Powell是直接向黃仁勳報告的約60名員工之一。《路透社》上週四則報導，黃仁勳還曾與另一名輝達員工有過關係，但該員工身分尚未公開。
黃仁勳與妻子Lori結婚超過40年，如今卻面臨令人震驚的聲譽逆轉。過去，他的領導形象建立在強悍的執行力，以及對輝達近乎傳奇般的掌控能力上。
輝達董事會現在正面臨一項艱鉅任務：尋找黃仁勳的接班人。目前公司已由長期擔任財務長的Colette Kress出任臨時執行長。
瑞銀分析師Tim Arcuri表示，「上週這場近期的管理層人事震盪發生後，我們聽到許多投資人對輝達長期產品藍圖感到擔憂。但我們認為這些疑慮被過度放大了，因為整個生態系統仍會持續推動產品藍圖向前發展。任何新任執行長幾乎都不會願意冒著失去競爭地位的風險，放棄每年推出新產品的節奏（儘管我們仍認為，採用更高密度設計的Kyber機櫃如今已不在考慮範圍內）。」
「至於新任執行長人選，我們認為公司很可能會從半導體及科技產業尋找人才，甚至可能嘗試從競爭對手挖角。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has not become so dominant as to surpass the entire industry he has personally driven into the AI boom. This reminder comes from an important client and frequent co‑speaker on tech topics, Cisco Chairman and CEO Chuck Robbins.

Robbins said on the "Sozzi Unleashed" show that "this industry is more important than any one person. I don’t care how brilliant you are; there are many smart people in this industry. Nvidia has 42,000 employees, other accelerator companies also have smart talent, and large‑scale cloud providers have many people developing this technology. We also have smart talent building AI and networking technology. The entire tech industry brings together a variety of top minds, so I’m not too worried about the future of the tech industry."

Jensen Huang founded Nvidia in 1993 and built the company into the most important player in the AI revolution. Today, after a series of explosive revelations and escalating controversies, he has been out of the CEO role for a full week.
According to the New York Times, Huang allegedly had a relationship with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, bringing unprecedented scrutiny to Nvidia.

The report also notes that Huang had a relationship with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell, one of about 60 employees who report directly to him. Reuters last Thursday reported that Huang had also been involved with another Nvidia employee, whose identity has not yet been disclosed.

Huang has been married to his wife Lori for over 40 years, but now faces a shocking reversal of reputation. In the past, his leadership image was built on fierce execution and near‑legendary control of Nvidia.
The Nvidia board now faces a daunting task: finding Huang’s successor. The company has appointed long‑time CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO.

Swiss‑based UBS analyst Tim Arcuri said, "After last week’s management shake‑up, we heard many investors worried about Nvidia’s long‑term product roadmap. We believe those concerns are overstated, because the entire ecosystem will continue to push the roadmap forward. Any new CEO would almost certainly not risk losing competitive position by abandoning the annual product cadence (although we still think the higher‑density Kyber cabinet is no longer in consideration)."
Regarding the new CEO, we believe the company is likely to look for talent in the semiconductor and tech industries, and may even try to poach from competitors."

items.title: 美股牛市還能跑多久？高盛：2027年再漲17% 標普上看8700點 但最強獲利成長階段已過
items.title_en: How Long Can the US Bull Market Run? Goldman Sachs: 17% Rise by 2027, S&P 500 Target 8,700 Points
paras: 高盛最新預測，美股牛市將延續至2027年，但回報率將較前幾年降溫，標普500指數明年底有望上看8700點，較目前水準上漲約17%，低於過去四年21%的年化報酬率。
高盛美股策略首席分析師Ben Snider在最新研究報告中表示，企業獲利成長仍是股市主要支撐，但隨著AI相關資本支出逐漸放緩，獲利增速也將回落。
Snider在報告中指出，標普成分股企業獲利增速將從2026年的30%降至2027年的18%，並可能持續放緩至2028年。「我們預估，隨著企業獲利成長放緩，2027年股票回報率也將有所回落。」
儘管如此，高盛認為目前美股估值仍屬合理。標普今年來持續刷新歷史高點，企業獲利快速成長使本益比倍數下降，目前指數預期本益比約18倍，待第三季財報全數公布後，標普500成分股企業可望連三季實現超過25%的獲利增長。
不過，2027年市場仍面臨兩大壓力：利率可能進一步走升，以及AI投資前景的不確定性，兩者皆可能限制股價上行空間。
Snider指出，企業獲利前景是2027年美股展望的最大變數。在悲觀情境下，若標普獲利預期回落至過去30年趨勢水準，同時本益比降至30年平均17倍，可能下跌約23%至5600點附近。反之，若AI資本支出週期比預期更強勁，或生產率成長超乎預期，推動獲利前景進一步改善，標普到2027年底可望上漲近30%至9400點。AI投資的持續性與實際回報，將決定下一階段美股表現。
產業配置上，高盛預估超大規模雲端企業將繼續受惠AI投資週期，長期大規模回購股票的「回購貴族」也有望表現突出。
值得注意的是，能源基礎設施供應商可能成為2027年獲利增長加速最明顯的群體之一，隨著AI相關基建持續推進，這類企業獲利前景可望改善。
此外，高盛建議關注醫療保健與必需消費品行業，這些類股能提供不同於科技股的配置選擇，在市場波動加劇時發揮分散風險的作用。
根據高盛判斷，2027年美股仍有望延續牛市，但驅動力將從AI資本開支帶動的高速增長，轉向更廣泛的企業獲利改善。對投資人而言，AI熱潮能否真正轉化為生產率提升與利潤增長，將決定標普最終趨近8700點的基準目標，或是向9400點的樂觀情境邁進。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs’ latest forecast suggests the US bull market will continue until 2027, but returns will cool off compared to previous years. The S&P 500 is expected to reach about 8,700 points by the end of next year, a rise of roughly 17% from current levels, below the 21% annualized return of the past four years.

Goldman Sachs’ U.S. equity strategy chief analyst Ben Snider said in a new research report that corporate earnings growth remains the main support for the market, but as AI‑related capital spending slows, earnings growth will also decline.

Snider noted that earnings growth for S&P component companies is projected to fall from 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027, and may continue to slow into 2028. ‘We expect that as corporate earnings growth slows, the 2027 stock return rate will also decline,’ he said.

Despite this, Goldman Sachs believes current U.S. equity valuations remain reasonable. The S&P has been breaking historical highs this year, and rapid earnings growth has lowered the price‑to‑earnings multiple to about 18×. After the full Q3 earnings are released, S&P component companies could achieve more than 25% earnings growth for three consecutive quarters.
However, the market will still face two major pressures in 2027: rates could rise further, and the uncertainty around AI investment prospects could limit upside potential.

Snider pointed out that corporate earnings prospects are the biggest variable for the 2027 U.S. equity outlook. In a pessimistic scenario, if S&P earnings expectations fall to the 30‑year trend level and the P/E ratio drops to the 30‑year average of 17×, the index could fall about 23% to around 5,600 points. Conversely, if AI capital spending cycles are stronger than expected or productivity growth exceeds expectations, pushing earnings prospects further, the S&P could rise nearly 30% to 9,400 points by the end of 2027. The sustainability and actual return of AI investment will determine the next phase of U.S. equity performance.

In terms of sector allocation, Goldman Sachs expects ultra‑large cloud companies to continue benefiting from the AI investment cycle, and long‑term large‑scale share‑repurchase “buy‑back aristocrats” are also likely to perform strongly.

Notably, energy infrastructure suppliers could become one of the most obvious groups to accelerate earnings growth in 2027, as AI‑related infrastructure continues to advance and improve the earnings outlook for these firms.

Additionally, Goldman Sachs recommends paying attention to healthcare and consumer staples, as these sectors offer a different allocation choice from tech stocks and can provide risk diversification when market volatility intensifies.

According to Goldman Sachs’ assessment, the U.S. equity market can still continue its bull run in 2027, but the driving force will shift from high‑growth AI capital spending to broader corporate earnings improvement. For investors, whether the AI boom can truly translate into productivity gains and profit growth will determine whether the S&P ultimately approaches the 8,700‑point target or moves toward the optimistic 9,400‑point scenario.

items.title: 〈台幣〉33元上下拋補激烈拉扯 國家隊蹲馬步穩台股匯市
items.title_en: Around NT$33, Fierce Toss‑and‑Catch; National Team Holds Steady to Stabilize Taiwan Stocks and FX
paras: 在外資龐大的出走潮下，台北股匯市今(18)日續弱，不僅加權指數又跌破4萬點關卡，最低來到39260點，跌點超過800點，新台幣也再度見貶破33元心理大關，不過，國家隊蹲馬步有效穩盤，台股盤中又翻紅，市場密切關注33元台幣價位是否為中央銀行的容忍底線。
新台幣今日以32.83元、升值2分開出後，隨即轉弱，盤中越最越低，截至11點15分最低來到33.002元，貶幅超過0.45%，是盤中最弱的主要亞幣。
反觀韓元升值達0.4%，人民幣、日元和星元小貶0.05%上下，美元指數則反彈0.1%左右。
法人分析，國安基金於4萬點伺機進場，觀察4萬點是否形成利空測試的第二隻腳，短線上台股將在AI大環境不確定下反覆利空測試，而今日適逢台指期結算，須提防外資壓低結算，並觀察轉倉後部位變化。
paras_en: Amid a massive outflow of foreign capital, Taipei's stock and foreign exchange markets continued to weaken today (the 18th), with the weighted index falling below the 40,000‑point threshold again, dropping to a low of 39,260 points, a decline of more than 800 points. The New Taiwan dollar also slipped past the psychological NT$33 barrier again. However, the “national team” took a defensive stance and effectively steadied the market, and the Taiwan stock market turned red again during trading. The market is closely watching whether the NT$33 level is the central bank’s tolerance floor.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at NT$32.83, up 0.02, but immediately weakened, sinking lower throughout the session. By 11:15 a.m., it fell to a low of NT$33.002, a depreciation of over 0.45%, making it the weakest major Asian currency intraday.
By contrast, the Korean won appreciated about 0.4%, while the Chinese yuan, Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each slipped roughly 0.05%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded about 0.1%.

Corporate analysts say the National Security Fund is waiting to enter around the 40,000‑point level, watching whether a second leg of a negative test forms at that point. In the short term, Taiwan stocks will undergo repeated negative tests amid uncertainty in the AI macro environment. Today also coincides with the settlement of Taiwan index futures, so caution is needed against foreign investors pushing prices down for settlement, and positions after the roll‑over should be monitored.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元回落但仍徘徊2025年4月來高點 美國經濟數據喜憂參半
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Falls Yet Still Near 2025‑April High as US Economic Data Shows Mixed Signals
paras: 美元週二(17日) 自近期高點回落，但仍接近 2025 年 4 月以來最強水準，美國公布的經濟數據喜憂參半，顯示消費支出維持穩定，但房市景氣轉弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌 0.1%，報 103.44。過去五個交易日累計上漲近 2%，美元指數近期受到通膨數據偏熱及聯準會(Fed)官員鷹派談話支撐。
不過，策略師認為，美元此次回落只是近期強勢反彈後的短暫停頓，而非更大幅度回檔的開始。
Corpay 首席市場策略師 Karl Schamotta 表示，「自上週聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller) 轉向鷹派立場，加上美國通膨加速升溫，推高市場利率預期並擴大各貨幣之間的利差以來，美元相較於所有主要貨幣對手幾乎一路占上風。」
週二公布的數據顯示，美國 10 月零售銷售溫和成長，但在物價上漲之際，家庭減少購買汽車及其他高單價商品。
另一項週二公布的調查顯示，11 月美國住宅建商信心大幅下滑，降至逾 14 年半以來低點。房貸利率上升使潛在買家暫緩購屋，加上移民政策收緊導致勞工短缺，進一步推高建商成本。
投資人仍深信，聯準會為了抑制通膨，將於 12 月升息。芝商所(CME)FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會 12 月將升息 1 碼。
Brown Brothers Harriman 外匯團隊全球市場策略主管 Elias Haddad 在報告中表示，「隨著其他主要央行收緊貨幣政策，與聯準會之間的政策分歧縮小，美元近期漲勢可能已經過度。」
Haddad 進一步指出，「儘管如此，美國經濟成長穩健、勞動市場狀況良好，加上核心通膨居高不下，仍使美元整體走勢偏向看漲。」
科技股動向
近期 AI 與科技股遭遇拋售，市場受到多項因素衝擊，包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長突然離職、美國期中選舉由民主黨大勝，以及市場擔憂以債務融資推動的 AI 基礎設施擴張可能帶來風險，投資人的風險偏好因此受到打擊，市場氣氛轉趨緊張。
接下來，輝達的財報及 Anthropic 預計週四登場的市場首秀，將成為檢驗市場對 AI 投資情緒的重要關鍵。
對風險較敏感的貨幣，包括澳幣與紐幣，過去六個交易日分別下跌 2.7% 與 2.3%。
若市場動盪進一步加劇，投資人可能轉向美元尋求避險，短期內有利美元走勢。然而，若 AI 投資題材遭遇更長時間的衝擊，這項長期主導美國市場的投資熱潮，也可能削弱市場對美元的需求。
Corpay 的 Schamotta 表示，「AI 投資題材一直是吸引外國資金流入美國資產的主要磁石之一。如果市場隨著時間推移逐漸降低對 AI 熱潮的預期，投資人就不會再問『我要躲到哪裡避險？』，而會開始思考『為什麼我的美國資產配置比重這麼高？』」
另一方面，歐元兌美元上漲 0.2%，至 1.10133 美元，稍早盤中一度跌至 1.0983 美元，創 19 個月新低。
Rabobank 外匯策略主管 Jane Foley 表示，市場可能先在 1.10 美元附近進入一段整理期，之後才會有足夠信心進一步推低歐元。
美元兌日元下跌 0.1%，至 159.30 日圓，距離 160 日元關卡僅一步之遙。交易員認為，160 日元可能是日本當局再次進場干預、支撐日元的觸發水準。
Foley 表示，「市場對干預措施抱持戒心，正是美元兌日元從 160 日元回落的原因之一。」她形容，160 日元是「極難突破」的關卡。
她補充指出，日本在 7 月與美國聯手干預匯市、支撐日元的行動，顯示日本政府捍衛本國貨幣的決心相當強烈。

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 103.44. Over the past five trading days it has risen almost 2%, with the index recently supported by hotter‑than‑expected inflation data and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials.
However, strategists say the dollar’s pullback is only a brief pause after a recent strong rebound, not the start of a larger correction.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said, “Since Fed Governor Christopher Waller turned hawkish last week and US inflation accelerated, pushing up market rate expectations and widening currency differentials, the dollar has been dominant against virtually all major peers.”
Data released on Tuesday showed US retail sales for October grew modestly, but as prices rose households cut back on buying cars and other high‑priced items.

Another survey released on Tuesday indicated US home‑builder confidence plunged sharply in November, falling to its lowest level in more than 14‑and‑a‑half years. Rising mortgage rates have delayed prospective buyers, and tighter immigration policy has created labor shortages that further raise builders’ costs.
Investors remain convinced the Fed will raise rates in December to curb inflation. CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect a one‑point rate hike at the December meeting.

Brown Brothers Harriman’s global markets FX chief Elias Haddad wrote, “With other major central banks tightening and the policy gap with the Fed narrowing, the dollar’s recent rally may already be over‑done.”
Haddad added, “Nevertheless, solid US economic growth, a strong labour market and persistently high core inflation keep the dollar’s overall outlook bullish.”
Tech‑stock moves

Recent AI and tech stocks have faced sell‑offs, hit by several factors including Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) CEO’s sudden departure, a Democratic landslide in the US mid‑term elections, and market worries that debt‑financed AI infrastructure expansion could pose risks, dampening investors’ risk appetite and tightening market sentiment.
Going forward, Nvidia’s earnings and Anthropic’s market debut slated for Thursday will be key gauges of sentiment toward AI investments.
Risk‑sensitive currencies such as the Australian and New Zealand dollars have each fallen over the past six trading days, down 2.7% and 2.3% respectively.

If market turbulence intensifies, investors may flee to the dollar for safety, supporting it in the short term. Yet if the AI theme suffers a prolonged hit, the long‑standing driver of US market inflows could also reduce demand for the greenback.

Schamotta of Corpay said, “AI has been one of the main magnets pulling foreign capital into US assets. If the market’s enthusiasm for AI wanes over time, investors will stop asking ‘Where should I hedge?’ and start questioning ‘Why is my US asset allocation so high?’”
On the other side, the euro rose 0.2% against the dollar to $1.10133, after briefly slipping to $1.0983 earlier in the session, a 19‑month low.
Rabobank FX strategy head Jane Foley said the market may first consolidate around $1.10 before gaining enough confidence to push the euro lower.
The dollar fell 0.1% against the yen to ¥159.30, just a step away from the ¥160 barrier. Traders think ¥160 could trigger another intervention by Japanese authorities to support the yen.
Foley noted, “Caution about possible intervention is one reason the dollar‑yen pair has retreated from ¥160,” describing ¥160 as a “very hard‑to‑break” level.
She added that Japan’s joint intervention with the US in July to support the yen showed the Japanese government’s strong resolve to defend its currency.
The pound rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.32215 as markets await Wednesday’s inflation data release.
