items.title: 從市場助力到「破壞球」：美元走強為何讓華爾街感到不安？
items.title_en: From Market Support to a ‘Disruptive Force’: Why a Stronger Dollar Is Making Wall Street Uneasy
paras: 美元指數在周二（17日）亞洲交易時段小幅回調0.1%，但周一來到103.7，創19個月新高，華爾街策略師開始擔憂若美元漲勢過快，原本支撐美國資產的強勢美元，反而可能成為加劇美股動盪的「破壞性力量」。
《MarketWatch》報導，美元正重新成為全球金融市場的重要變量。美國經濟表現強於其他主要經濟體、AI基礎設施投資持續吸引海外資金，加上Fed可能進一步升息，推動美元近期加速走強。
美銀全球研究部投資策略師Michael Hartnett上周警告，若美元持續飆升，將成為全球金融市場的「破壞球」，對風險資產構成嚴重威脅。專家指出，美國經濟相對強勁、利率預期偏高，加上AI投資熱潮吸引海外資金，正推升美元走勢。
分析認為，美元升值通常伴隨融資成本上升與金融條件緊縮，對全球股市、債市等風險資產形成普遍壓力。
歷史數據顯示，多數資產與美元呈負相關，僅原油及能源股例外。此外，美元走強將加重以美元借貸的海外企業償債負擔，並可能使國際資金回流美國，進一步壓抑非美市場表現。
在AI浪潮方面，高盛策略師發現，美元漲勢與AI相關股票表現密切連動，無論市場涨跌皆然。AI企業股價走強吸引海外資金湧入，形成「AI股漲—美元升」的正向循環。
高盛預估，美元升值態勢可能延續至2027年，但速度將放緩。不過，若資料中心建設因故減速，AI動能減弱，美元升勢也將面臨回落風險。
Fed後續利率決策仍是關鍵變數。市場預期Fed可能繼續升息，支撐美元偏強格局。
Sevens Report Research創辦人Tom Essaye指出，短期美股或許尚能承受，但若美元指數升至105或更高水平，將開始對標普500等主要指數造成實質衝擊，投資人須嚴防美元過熱引發的金融動盪。
paras_en: The dollar index slipped 0.1% during Asian trading on Tuesday (the 17th), but on Monday it rose to 103.7, a 19‑month high, prompting Wall Street strategists to worry that if the dollar’s rise accelerates, the strong dollar that has been supporting U.S. assets could instead become a “disruptive force” that fuels volatility in U.S. equities.

MarketWatch reports that the dollar is re‑emerging as a key variable in global financial markets. A U.S. economy that is performing better than other major economies, continued overseas inflows into AI infrastructure investments, and the prospect of further Fed rate hikes are all driving the dollar’s recent acceleration.

Bank of America Global Research investment strategist Michael Hartnett warned last week that a persistently soaring dollar would become a “disruptive ball” for global financial markets, posing a serious threat to risk assets. Experts note that a relatively strong U.S. economy, higher‑than‑expected rate expectations, and the AI investment boom attracting foreign capital are all pushing the dollar higher.
Analysts say that dollar appreciation usually comes with higher financing costs and tighter financial conditions, creating broad pressure on global equities, bonds and other risk assets.

Historical data show that most assets have a negative correlation with the dollar, with oil and energy stocks as the only exceptions. A stronger dollar also raises the debt‑servicing burden for overseas companies that borrow in dollars and could trigger a repatriation of international capital to the United States, further dampening performance in non‑U.S. markets.

On the AI front, Goldman Sachs strategists have found that the dollar’s rise is closely linked to the performance of AI‑related stocks, regardless of overall market direction. Strong AI stock gains attract foreign capital, creating a positive feedback loop of “AI stock rally → dollar rise.”

Goldman Sachs projects that the dollar’s appreciation could continue through 2027, albeit at a slower pace. However, if data‑center construction slows for any reason and AI momentum weakens, the dollar’s upward trajectory could face a pull‑back risk.
Future Fed rate decisions remain a key variable. Markets expect the Fed may keep raising rates, supporting a relatively strong dollar environment.

Tom Essaye, founder of Sevens Report Research, notes that U.S. equities may still hold up in the short term, but if the dollar index climbs to 105 or higher, it will begin to deliver material blows to major indices such as the S&P 500, and investors need to guard against financial turbulence sparked by an overheated dollar.

items.title: 47層金色高塔成形！川普圖書館頭七月募5760萬美元 金主來源不透明  ABC、Meta和解金藏多少？
items.title_en: Golden 47‑Story Tower Takes Shape! Trump Library Raises $57.6 Million in First Seven Months, Funding Sources Opaque, How Much of ABC, Meta Settlement Money Is Hidden?
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國總統川普籌建總統圖書館的基金會，成立前七個月累計募得5760萬美元，超出原先預期，但資金來源缺乏透明度，未披露捐贈者身份，也無法確認巨額訴訟和解款的實際到帳規模，工程建設用地也面臨法律爭議。
根據《華盛頓郵報》與《CNN》周一(16日)報導，去年稅務申報文件顯示，基金會截至去年底籌得5760萬美元，為川普打算在邁阿密市中心興建的47層樓圖書館提供初步資金。該建築入口採金色裝飾，擬展示一架空軍一號飛機且可能兼具飯店功能。文件中未公開捐贈者名單，也未說明《ABC》、Meta、派拉蒙等企業支付的訴訟和解金在籌款總額中佔比。
基金會原向美國國稅局(IRS)預估2025年底籌資約5000萬美元，實際金額高出760萬美元。基金會曾預估2027年底累計籌資近10億美元，但最新文件未提籌款目標能否實現的資訊。
支出方面，基金會成立前七個月僅花費約34.9萬美元，大部分支付給建築設計公司Bermello Ajamil & Partners，用於製作效果圖。
基金會由五人董事會管理，包括川普次子艾利克、女婿麥可·布洛斯及律師詹姆斯·凱利。文件顯示，去年管理人員及受托人均未支薪。
資金來源受關注的關鍵在於和解安排。2024年大選期間及川普第一任期結束後，他對多家媒體與科技企業提告，部分企業以和解收場並同意撥款。ABC於2024年12月同意支付1500萬美元；Meta於2025年1月指定2200萬美元；《CBS》母公司派拉蒙達成總額1600萬美元和解，扣除費用後餘款轉交，三項和解金合計5300萬美元，但文件未列各筆到帳金額，故無法確認5760萬中有多少直接來自這些和解金。
此外，佛州州長德桑提斯去年協助推動，將邁阿密市中心一塊原屬邁阿密戴德學院、估值約6300萬美元的土地轉交基金會。不過多名南佛州居民已提告阻止，並將川普、基金會、佛州政府及學院列為被告。川普等已請求聯邦法官駁回，爭議未決。
初期籌款雖超預期，基金會距2027年底近10億美元目標仍差距甚遠。在捐款名單與和解金流向未公開下，這座「金色圖書館」的資金透明度與潛在利益衝突疑雲，將持續受公眾檢視。
paras_en: Foreign media reports say the foundation set up to build former President Trump’s presidential library raised $57.6 million in its first seven months, exceeding expectations but lacking transparency about donors and the actual amount of large litigation settlement funds that have been received, while the construction site also faces legal disputes.

According to the Washington Post and CNN on Monday (the 16th), tax filings from last year show the foundation had raised $57.6 million by year‑end, providing seed money for the planned 47‑story library in downtown Miami. The building’s entrance will be gilded, it is slated to display a Air Force One aircraft and may also include a hotel component. The filings do not disclose the list of donors nor explain what share of the total comes from settlement payments by companies such as ABC, Meta and Paramount.

The foundation had originally projected to the IRS that it would raise about $50 million by the end of 2025; the actual amount was $7.6 million higher. It had also forecast nearly $1 billion in cumulative fundraising by the end of 2027, but the latest documents contain no information on whether that target is still realistic.
On the expense side, the foundation spent only about $349,000 in its first seven months, most of which went to the architectural firm Bermello Ajamil & Partners for rendering work.

The foundation is overseen by a five‑member board that includes Trump’s son Eric, son‑in‑law Michael Boulos and lawyer James Kelly. The filings show that none of the managers or trustees received a salary last year.

The source of the money is under scrutiny because of settlement arrangements. During the 2024 election cycle and after Trump left office, he sued several media and tech firms, some of which settled and agreed to fund the foundation. ABC agreed in December 2024 to pay $15 million; Meta earmarked $22 million in January 2025; CBS parent Paramount reached a settlement totaling $16 million, with the balance after fees transferred to the foundation. The three settlements total $53 million, but the filings do not list the amounts actually received, so it is unclear how much of the $57.6 million comes directly from those settlements.

In addition, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis helped last year to transfer a parcel of land in downtown Miami, formerly owned by Miami‑Dade College and valued at about $63 million, to the foundation. Several South‑Florida residents have sued to block the transfer, naming Trump, the foundation, the state government and the college as defendants. Trump and co‑defendants have asked a federal judge to dismiss the case, and the dispute remains unresolved.

Although early fundraising exceeded expectations, the foundation is still far from its near‑$1 billion goal for the end of 2027. With donor lists and settlement flows undisclosed, the financial transparency and potential conflicts of interest surrounding the “golden library” will continue to draw public scrutiny.

items.title: 〈台幣〉又驚見33元 央行阻貶？收盤前轉升收32.85元
items.title_en: NTD Again Threatens 33: Central Bank Halts Decline? Rises to 32.85 Before Close
paras: 美股動盪令外資持續出走，造成今(17)日台股又見大逃殺壓力，在國安基金護盤下終場驚險守住4萬點心理大關，而台北匯市也見到中央銀行出手調節維持動態穩定，雖一度貶破33元大關，收盤前半小時轉升值，終場收在32.85元，升值3.6分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值衝上28.24億美元，可見拋補雙方的拉距戰相當激烈。
新台幣今日以32.89元、貶值0.4分開出後，隨著台股上下大幅震盪，最低一度貶至33.015元，不過，在央行強調實戰穩盤的態度下，收盤前意外轉升，收在全日最高點，高低價差達1.65角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元震盪幅度大但目前貶幅僅0.1%左右，美元指數處平盤附近，星元和人民幣小升不到0.05%，新台幣收升0.11%，日元彈升0.15%左右，泰銖也彈約0.2%上下。
法人認為，黃仁勳下台市場又傳出輝達新伺服器 Rubin 延後放量，整體AI 產業疑慮待釐清，造成內資的融資籌碼也湧出停損，雖今日多頭軍有效守4萬點關卡上，但盤勢續挫，瀰漫偏悲觀的氣氛，首場沒有黃仁勳的輝達法說會將登場，市場如何回應須密切關注。
paras_en: U.S. equity turbulence continued to drive foreign investors out, putting the Taiwan market under a fresh wave of sell‑off pressure on the 17th. With the National Security Fund stepping in to support, the market narrowly held the psychological 40,000‑point barrier. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market, the central bank intervened to maintain dynamic stability; the New Taiwan dollar briefly slipped past the 33‑per‑U.S.‑dollar mark but recovered in the last half‑hour, closing at 32.85, a gain of 0.036. Transaction volume at Taipei FX brokers surged to $2.824 billion, indicating a fierce tug‑of‑war between buyers and sellers.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.89, down 0.004, and as the Taiwan stock index swung wildly it fell as low as 33.015. However, under the central bank’s firm stance on stabilizing the market, the currency unexpectedly rose before the close, ending at the day's high with a spread of 0.165 between the high and low.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won showed the largest volatility but was down only about 0.1%. The U.S. Dollar Index hovered near flat. The Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each edged up less than 0.05%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.11%, the Japanese yen jumped roughly 0.15%, and the Thai baht rebounded about 0.2%.

Institutional investors note that after Jensen Huang’s departure, rumors surfaced that Nvidia’s new Rubin server rollout would be delayed, leaving doubts over the broader AI sector. This prompted domestic leveraged positions to unwind. Although bullish forces managed to keep the market above the 40,000‑point line today, the overall trend remained weak, fostering a pessimistic atmosphere. Nvidia’s first earnings call without Huang is set to take place, and market reaction will need close monitoring.

items.title: 強美元恐成全球股市破壞球 華爾街緊盯105關鍵警戒線
items.title_en: Strong Dollar May Become a Global Market Disruptor, Wall Street Watches the Critical 105 Threshold
paras: 美元漲勢加速，華爾街開始警戒強美元對股市的衝擊。美國經濟韌性、人工智慧（AI）資本支出熱潮與升息預期，持續吸引海外資金流入，但美元走強也可能推升借貸與償債壓力。美銀警告，若美元延續目前漲勢，恐成為衝擊全球市場的「破壞球」。
根據FactSet數據，ICE美元指數周一(16日)一度觸及103.69，創2025年4月2日以來最高。
美銀全球研究投資策略師Michael Hartnett在近期客戶報告中指出：「如果美元按照這種節奏繼續飆升，它終將演變成一顆破壞球。」
Manulife John Hancock Investments聯席首席投資策略師Emily Roland表示，美元近期走強，主要受到市場預期聯準會可能持續升息，以及美國經濟相較其他經濟體更具韌性所帶動。
她更擔心的是，這波升勢反映市場預期借貸成本將進一步提高，而這通常會壓抑全球風險資產。
Roland提醒，美元走強期間，美股表現通常優於非美股市，但市場接下來仍可能面臨金融環境收緊的考驗。美國大型優質股通常更有能力抵禦風險，資金最終可能轉向資產負債表健全、現金流充沛的企業。
她與同僚Matt Miskin分析美元與各類資產的長期相關性後發現，多數資產與美元呈負相關，意味美元升值時，這些資產往往承壓。兩人在報告中指出，原油及能源類股是少數與美元維持弱正相關的資產類別。
強美元也將加重部分海外企業的負擔。Roland表示，對於背負美元債務、本國貨幣卻走貶的企業而言，美元匯率上升將顯著推高償債成本。
這波美元強勢，與去年的走勢形成鮮明對比。2025年ICE美元指數大幅走弱，寫下有紀錄以來最差年度表現之一；今年則受惠於較穩健的美國經濟基本面，吸引追求超額報酬的海外資金流入，進一步鞏固美元強勢。
高盛策略師指出，今年美元走強，也與預期受惠於AI的企業股價優於大盤有關。團隊表示，無論市場行情好壞，美元表現似乎都與AI相關股票的走勢存在關聯。
除了AI熱潮，美國利率上升也提高美元吸引力。高盛預期，美元強勢將延續至2027年，升值趨勢仍將持續，但步伐可能放緩。
不過，AI投資動能也可能左右美元後續走勢。Roland認為，AI已是當前經濟成長不可或缺的核心引擎，若算力瓶頸或建設週期等因素導致資料中心建設放緩，美元加速上漲的動能也可能隨之降溫。
Sevens Report Research創辦人兼總裁Tom Essaye則認為，市場對聯準會進一步升息的預期，仍將為美元提供支撐。
他提醒，儘管股市目前可能尚屬安全，一旦ICE美元指數突破105，甚至更高的關鍵阻力位，強美元的外溢效應恐對美股主要指數造成實質打擊。
paras_en: The dollar's rally is accelerating, prompting Wall Street to warn of its impact on equity markets. US economic resilience, a surge in AI‑related capital spending and expectations of further rate hikes continue to draw overseas capital, but a stronger dollar could also raise borrowing and debt‑service pressures. Bank of America warns that if the dollar maintains its current rise, it could become a "disruptive ball" that hits global markets.
According to FactSet data, the ICE Dollar Index touched 103.69 on Monday (the 16th), the highest level since April 2, 2025.
Bank of America Global Research investment strategist Michael Hartnett wrote in a recent client note: "If the dollar keeps soaring at this pace, it will eventually turn into a disruptive ball."

Manulife John Hancock Investments co‑Chief Investment Strategist Emily Roland said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly driven by market expectations that the Fed may keep raising rates and by the US economy’s relative resilience compared with other economies.
She added that she is concerned this rally reflects market expectations of higher borrowing costs, which typically suppress global risk assets.

Roland cautioned that while a strong dollar usually sees US equities outperform non‑US markets, the market may still face tightening financial conditions. Large‑cap, high‑quality US stocks are generally better positioned to weather risk, and capital may ultimately flow to companies with strong balance sheets and robust cash flows.

After analyzing the long‑term correlation between the dollar and various assets with colleague Matt Miskin, she found that most assets have a negative correlation with the dollar, meaning they tend to be pressured when the dollar appreciates. In their report they noted that crude oil and energy stocks are among the few asset classes that maintain a weak positive correlation with the dollar.

A strong dollar also adds burden to some overseas firms. Roland said that for companies carrying dollar‑denominated debt while their local currencies depreciate, a higher dollar exchange rate will significantly increase debt‑service costs.

This dollar strength contrasts sharply with last year’s trend. In 2025 the ICE Dollar Index weakened sharply, posting one of the worst annual performances on record; this year, buoyed by a more solid US economic foundation, it has attracted overseas capital seeking excess returns, further cementing the dollar’s strength.

Goldman Sachs strategists pointed out that this year’s dollar rally is also linked to expectations that AI‑benefiting stocks will outperform the broader market. The team said that regardless of market conditions, the dollar’s performance appears tied to the trajectory of AI‑related equities.

Beyond the AI boom, rising US rates have also boosted the dollar’s appeal. Goldman Sachs expects the dollar’s strength to persist through 2027, with the appreciation trend continuing, albeit at a potentially slower pace.

However, AI investment momentum could also influence the dollar’s future path. Roland believes AI is now an indispensable engine of economic growth, and if factors such as compute bottlenecks or construction cycles slow data‑center builds, the momentum behind a faster‑rising dollar could cool off.
Tom Essaye, founder and president of Sevens Report Research, said market expectations of further Fed rate hikes will continue to support the dollar.

He warned that although the stock market may still seem safe for now, once the ICE Dollar Index breaks above 105—or even higher key resistance levels—the spill‑over effects of a strong dollar could deliver a tangible hit to major US equity indices.
